plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-permit-report-check — Administrative licensing application register completeness and date consistency check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-permit-report-check` reads one 行政许可办理台账 — the applicant header plus one row per application item — and checks that register's own closed loop and internal consistency: that each item listed in the 申请材料 column records whether it was submitted, that 受理日期 does not fall after 决定日期, that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and the 承诺办结日 the register itself records, that 决定结果 comes from the vocabulary you configured, that a record whose 决定结果 marks a grant carries its 许可证号, that the header names its 申请人 and 申请事项, and that no 许可事项 is registered twice in the table.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-permit-report-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-permit-report-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-permit-report-check: real output over its PR-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permit-report-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-permit-report-check-hero.png)

![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permit-report-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permit-report-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-permit-report-check-demo.gif)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PR-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row lists materials in 申请材料, but 已提交材料 is blank — is that reported? | Yes. `PR-001` requires a `submittedItems` value on every row whose 申请材料 cell is filled, and reports the row when the submission column is empty. It reads the register's own materials column and checks only whether the submission is recorded: it does not compare that list with the matter's service guide, and does not judge whether the materials submitted are complete or compliant. If no row has a filled 申请材料 cell, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| 受理日期 is later than 决定日期 — will that be caught? | Yes. `PR-002` compares the two dates the register itself carries, `acceptedAt` against `decidedAt`, treats the same day as not later, and reports the row where acceptance follows the decision. It only compares those two dates: it does not judge whether the acceptance was lawful or whether the application should have been accepted. A date it cannot parse is reported as its own finding rather than skipped silently. |
| What happens when the 承诺办结日 column is empty — and is the 法定时限 column checked at all? | `PR-003` reports itself in `skipped`: no day count is built in, because statutory periods are counted in working days, may be extended and may exclude hearing or expert-review time, so the only baseline is the 承诺办结日 (`dueAt`) the register states. No rule reads the 法定时限 (`legalDays`) column. When `dueAt` is filled, the rule checks that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and it; a finding means the decision disagrees with the deadline you recorded, never that it was late. |
| I wrote 补正后准予 into 决定结果. Is that accepted? | `PR-004` checks 决定结果 against the vocabulary in its `values` parameter, and that parameter ships empty — so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of judging your wording. Fill `values` with the outcomes your institution records (for example 不予受理) and any value not on that list is reported. The rule checks only whether the value is on the list; it does not judge whether the decision is correct or lawful. |
| A record says 准予 but the 许可证号 column is blank. | `PR-005` reports it: when 决定结果 matches a grant marker — `conditionValues`, by default 准予 / 准予许可 / 通过 / 同意 / 已办结 / 批准 — the record must carry its 许可证号 (`certificateNo`). It checks only that the number is filled in, not whether the certificate is genuine, valid or served. With no row matching a grant marker, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| The same 许可事项 appears in two rows. | `PR-007` reports the later row and names the row it duplicates, because two registrations of one matter make the deadline check ambiguous. It checks uniqueness only, and a hit needs human confirmation: one project applying for several matters may legitimately look the same, so distinguish it in the materials column rather than deleting the row. Differences in whitespace are ignored; with no 许可事项 column the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 | 现行版本与条号本次未核实 | PR-001, PR-002, PR-005, PR-006, PR-007 |
| 各事项办事指南与承诺时限（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为台账写明的承诺办结日）—— ⚠️ 法定上限见《行政许可法》第四十二条，本条不引用该条 | PR-003 |
| 本机构许可办理管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的结果口径）—— ⚠️ 法定决定类型见《行政许可法》第三十八条，本条不引用该条 | PR-004 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **行政许可办理台账** for the closed loop a register can be held to — that each
application item records its submission, that acceptance does not follow the decision, that the decision falls
between acceptance and the promised completion date, that the decision outcome comes from your vocabulary, that a
grant records its certificate number, that the register names its applicant and matter, and that matters are not
double-registered. It does **not** decide whether a permit decision was lawful, whether the materials were
complete or compliant, whether an application should be accepted, or whether a permit should be granted.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not judge
>
> **It does not check whether the materials list is complete.** It reads the register's **own** 申请材料 column
> and checks that each listed item records whether it was submitted — **not** whether that list matches the
> matter's service guide. Verifying the list means comparing it against the guide, which this plugin does not do.
>
> **No statutory period is built in — and the statute says why that is the right call.**
> 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》was read verbatim (see `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md`), and three of its
> provisions make a built-in number unusable: **article 82 requires statutory periods to be counted in working
> days, excluding public holidays**; article 42 sets twenty days with a ten-day extension (forty-five plus
> fifteen for joint handling); and article 45 excludes time needed for hearings, testing, inspection and expert
> review from the period altogether. A register normally records calendar dates, so `PR-003` compares the decision
> date against the **promised completion date written in the register**, and reports itself in `skipped` when that
> column is empty. A finding means "this disagrees with the deadline you recorded", never "this was late".
>
> ⚠️ **The text read was the 2003 promulgation**; a 2019 amendment exists and **was not obtained**, so the pack
> keeps the note 「现行版本与条号本次未核实」 on every rule and claims no article is current law.
>
> **The outcome vocabulary ships empty.** Wording for grants, refusals and terminations varies by institution
> and matter, so `PR-004` reports itself in `skipped` until you configure it, and `PR-005` (which requires a
> certificate number once a grant is recorded) uses a configurable set of grant marker values rather than a
> built-in list.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The
> regime lives in 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 and in each matter's service guide. The verification pass could
> not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every
> rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and
> raise `kind` to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=2

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bgame

DSH Web 小游戏插件。包含德州扑克、21 点、五子棋和 UNO，可与电脑或已配置的模型对战。当前版本为 `0.4.0`。

## 安装

需要 Node.js 24 或以上，以及已经初始化 Web profile 的 DeepSeek Harness。当前验证版本为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`。

### 快速安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kiteluo/dsh-bgame
```

安装后启动 DSH Web 或刷新已运行的页面，在左侧导航和插件列表中打开 **dsh-bgame**。该命令使用当前 `DSH_HOME` 下的 Web profile。

### 从源码安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Kiteluo/dsh-bgame.git
cd dsh-bgame
npm install
node install.mjs
```

安装器使用 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`，未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时默认使用 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。在本地 DSH 工作区的 `plugins/` 目录下运行时，也会识别该工作区已有的 `.dsh/profiles/web`。可显式指定 profile：

```sh
node install.mjs --profile /path/to/.dsh/profiles/web
```

安装器登记本地 link 依赖和插件 bundle，同步已有 pnpm 锁文件，备份修改前的配置，并迁移旧名称 `dsh-arcade`。重复执行不会重复登记。插件源码目录需要保留，目录链接会指向它。

首次安装后启动 DSH Web；已在运行的服务会热加载插件配置。刷新网页，左侧导航和「插件 → 已安装」中均显示 **dsh-bgame**，插件详情提供「打开游戏大厅」。

## 使用

- **电脑对手**：简单、普通、困难三档，本地运行，不调用模型。简单偏随机；普通采用基础规则策略；困难五子棋检查获胜、阻挡和双重威胁，德扑用公开信息抽样估算胜率，UNO 在对手手牌较少时优先阻止其出牌。21 点庄家固定在 17 点停牌，不受难度影响。
- **模型对手**：使用 DSH 中已配置的模型服务，消耗该模型的调用额度。模型只能看到自己的手牌和公开信息，程序验证其走法。
- **暂停 / 回到工作**：取消当前游戏请求并保存进度，不向工作会话插入消息。
- **自动存档**：每款游戏保存一局，重新打开可继续；电脑难度、模型出招方式和失败处理选项也会保存。旧版 `dsh-arcade` 的浏览器存档会自动读取；清除站点数据会删除存档。

模型提供两种出招方式：

| 方式 | 思考档位 | 输出上限 | 等待上限 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 快速出招 | 优先关闭思考；无法关闭时使用较低档位 | 8192 token | 60 秒 |
| 认真思考 | 使用模型支持的中等或较高档位 | 16384 token | 90 秒 |

认真思考可能增加等待时间和调用费用；无推理档位的模型仍按服务默认运行，出招后显示实际档位。失败时默认停在当前回合，提供「重试模型」「电脑代打本步」；也可选择「电脑自动接手」。代打按所选电脑难度执行，只替代当前一步，下一次仍由模型行动。模型返回完整合法的 JSON 走法后，即使结束标记为输出额度用尽，也会保留它的选择。

对局页显示当前回合、已走步数、上一手动作；模型思考期间显示实时等待时间。德扑额外显示底池、本轮最高下注、双方本轮下注及你需要跟注的金额。暂停、返回大厅或切换设置会取消旧请求，旧回复不会重复落子。

## 游戏规则

| 游戏 | 范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 德州扑克 | 双人无限注，盲注 10/20，完整四轮下注及最佳五张牌比较；按有效筹码限制下注，不设边池 |
| 21 点 | 庄家含软 17 停牌，天然 21 点赔 3:2，可加倍；不含分牌与保险 |
| 五子棋 | 15×15 自由五子棋，黑先，无禁手，连续五子或以上获胜 |
| UNO | 108 张牌，双人局，跳过/反转/+2/+4/换色；不叠罚牌、不设质疑，自动喊 UNO |

德扑与 21 点使用虚拟筹码，每局重新分配。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) · Copyright (c) 2026 Kiteluo

plugins.description: DSH 插件：上游网关按图片张数拒绝请求时，把最旧的图片卸载为占位文本并重试，恢复卡死的视觉模型会话（复用官方 image/offload 投影）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-count-guard

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A fallback plugin for DSH visual-model sessions that hit an image-count limit.

## The problem it solves

An upstream gateway may enforce a hard cap on the number of images in a single request (measured on OpenCode Go: **20 images**). The `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter, however, budgets images **purely by base64 bytes** (`maxRequestImageBytes`, 20 MiB by default), with no budget for image count, so:

1. images accumulate in the session history until there are 36 of them (11.79 MiB raw / roughly 15.72 MiB as base64);
2. after switching to a visual model (`opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`), 15.72 MiB < 20 MiB, so the adapter considers the request fine and sends all 36 images inline;
3. the gateway replies `400 INVALID_REQUEST`: `a request may include at most 20 images`;
4. the official `dsh-compaction-image-offload` only recognizes `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED`, not this error code → the step fails;
5. from then on **every step of that session fails** (sending "continue" again makes no difference) and the session is completely stuck.

## What it does

It hooks into the `agent/request-error` waterfall:

- when the failure text matches an image-count limit (`at most N images` / `maximum of N images` / `no more than N images` / `up to N images` / `too many images`, and the word "image" must appear);
- it counts the total number of image occurrences on the current surface that are **not yet omitted**, `total`;
- it records an `image/offload` decision, picking the oldest `max(1, total - (limit - safetyMargin))` occurrences in model request order;
- it returns `{ kind: 'retry' }`, and the step is retried (without spending the provider retry budget).

It reuses the same official `image/offload` projection, so placeholder text, replay, token accounting, and KV cache semantics all match official offloading. Every retry omits at least one occurrence, so **recovery always terminates**: either the request fits, or there is nothing left to omit and the original failure stays terminal (no infinite retries).

## Relationship to the official image-offload

| Case | Handled by |
|---|---|
| The adapter rejects on its own byte budget (`IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED`) | Official `dsh-compaction-image-offload` |
| The upstream gateway rejects on **image count** (`INVALID_REQUEST`, etc.) | This plugin |

Both write the same kind of `image/offload` event, so they do not conflict. This plugin does not depend on the official handler's registration order, only on the `image/offload` projection being registered; if the projection is not registered (the official plugin is disabled), `append` throws, and the plugin catches that and hands the failure back downstream without side effects.

## Installation

```powershell
# run this from the cloned repository directory
pwsh -File .\install.ps1                 # install into the desktop profile (default)
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Profile web    # install into the given profile
```

The script edits three places in the profile by hand (`dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` / `pnpm-lock.yaml`) and copies a duplicate of node_modules (**without running pnpm install**, to avoid incidentally upgrading other `^` dependencies); before editing, it backs everything up to `.backup\<timestamp>\` (keeping only the 5 most recent).

All insertion points use structural anchors (`"dependencies": {`, `"bundles": [`, and the `packages:` / `snapshots:` section headers in the lock file), so they do not depend on whether other plugins are present, nor on any machine-specific path. The DSH home directory comes from `$env:DSH_HOME`, falling back to `~\.dsh`.

**You must restart DSH after installing.**

Uninstall:

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall
```

## Configuration (optional)

No configuration is needed by default. When you do need it, override by id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: image-count-guard
  config:
    defaultImageLimit: 20      # assumed limit when the error text gives no number
    safetyMargin: 2            # margin kept after offloading, so adding one more image does not fail again
    maxOffloadPerRetry: 80     # maximum number of images omitted per retry
```

## Verification

1. Static: at the end, `install.ps1` prints four checks: deps / bundles / node_modules / lock.
2. Offline unit tests: `node --test test/guard.test.mjs` (11 cases covering matching, selection, the upper bound on convergence rounds, and the no-side-effect boundary).
3. Assembly check (optional): mount the plugin into a temporary profile and run `--dump-config` to confirm the entry is assembled. Measured output contains `# == dsh-image-count-guard` / `- id: image-count-guard`, exit code 0.
4. Live: after restarting, open the stuck session and send "continue". With the plugin active, that session records an `image/offload` event, and the next request succeeds.

## Diagnostics tool

```powershell
# single session: image count, omitted count, raw bytes, base64 estimate, average image size
node tools\session-image-report.mjs `
     "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\sessions\<workspace>\session-<id>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd"

# scan recent sessions, sorted by image count
node tools\session-image-report.mjs "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\sessions" --limit 20
```

Measured on two kinds of session:

| Session | Images | base64 payload | Average image | Would a byte-only budget stop it? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session-c312057f` | 36 | 15.72 MiB | 335 KiB | No (below the 20 MiB default budget; not a single image gets offloaded) |
| `session-b15b99cb` | 25 | 1.52 MiB | 47 KiB | No (the bytes are too small, so even a tightened budget is hard to align with image count) |

The second row is why this plugin exists: an image count over the limit has nothing to do with the byte budget, and only count-based handling stops it.

## Known limits

- **Offloading cannot be undone**: an omitted image appears as placeholder text from then on (including a read-only path to the attachment), which is inherent to the official `image/offload` semantics. If you need to see the image again, have the model call `read_image` once more.
- The error text must be in English and contain both `image` and a quantity phrase; when a new gateway wording appears, add an entry to `LIMIT_PATTERNS` in `src/index.js`.
- After changing `src/index.js` you must re-run `install.ps1` to sync the node_modules copy, otherwise DSH keeps loading the old code.

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 直接驱动本机 Microsoft Edge 的 Host 插件：CDP 启动/接管、开标签、导航、执行 JS、取正文、截图、点击、输入。零第三方依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-edge-browser

> 项目仓库：https://github.com/lingziba/dshedge （包名 `dsh-edge-browser`，项目名 `dshedge`）

让 DSH 直接驱动**本机 Microsoft Edge**：启动/接管浏览器、开标签页、导航、执行 JS、
读正文、截图、点击、输入。零第三方依赖（只用 `node:` 内置模块 + 自实现的 WebSocket 客户端）。

## 它怎么工作

```
DSH agent  ──edge_* 工具──▶  插件（Host 进程）  ──CDP──▶  Edge (--remote-debugging-port)
                                     │                        ▲
                                     └── 专用 user-data-dir ───┘
```

- 走 Edge 自带的 DevTools 协议（CDP）：HTTP `/json/*` 管目标，WebSocket 发命令。
- **专用配置目录**（默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-edge-browser\profile`）：既满足 Chromium 136+
  "远程调试必须使用非默认 profile" 的要求，也不会碰到你日常在用的那个 Edge 会话。
- 懒加载：只有真正操作浏览器时才建立 WebSocket；关掉标签页不会退出浏览器。
- 不用 Playwright/Puppeteer：不下载浏览器、不带额外依赖，直接用已安装的 Edge。

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `edge_status` | 只读探测：调试端口是否可达、版本、可执行文件、配置目录、当前标签页 |
| `edge_launch` | 启动（或复用）可控制的 Edge，可选直接打开一个网址；`headless: true` 无头运行 |
| `edge_tabs` | 列出标签页，拿到 `targetId` |
| `edge_open` | 新标签页打开网址，并设为后续调用的默认目标 |
| `edge_navigate` | 让已有标签页跳转，并等到 `document.readyState === 'complete'` |
| `edge_eval` | 在页面里执行 JS 表达式，返回 JSON 文本（支持 await Promise） |
| `edge_text` | 取 `document.body.innerText` 正文 + 标题 + 地址 |
| `edge_screenshot` | 截图落盘（PNG/JPEG、可整页），返回路径供 `read_image` 看图 |
| `edge_click` | 按 CSS 选择器或可见文本点击；滚动到可见处后发真实鼠标事件 |
| `edge_type` | 聚焦输入框、清空、输入文本，可 `submit: true` 回车 |
| `edge_close` | 关某个标签页；`shutdown: true` 退出整个可控制实例 |

典型用法：`edge_launch` → `edge_navigate` → `edge_text` / `edge_eval` → 需要看图时 `edge_screenshot` + `read_image`。

## 安装

拿到代码（二选一）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lingziba/dshedge.git D:\dsh-plugins\dshedge
# 或网页上 Code → Download ZIP，解压到同一位置
```

装进 DSH profile：

```text
plugin_manager  install_bundle  target=D:\dsh-plugins\dshedge
```

装完让 agent 跑一次 `edge_status`：看到 `插件构建：1.0.4` 和 Edge 版本就成了。
不想启动浏览器也可以先跑 `node test/definitions.mjs`（期望 20/20，秒级，会校验 schema 是否被当前 DSH 接受）。

目录请放在**之后不会移动**的位置——profile 里记录的是该目录的绝对 link 路径，移动后重新安装一次即可。
卸载：`plugin_manager remove_bundle target=dsh-edge-browser`（target 是**包名**，不是仓库名）。

## 配置（bundle 行 `config`，全部可省略）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `port` | `9222` | Edge 调试端口 |
| `executablePath` | 自动探测 | Windows / macOS / Linux 常见安装位置 + `PATH`；也可用环境变量 `DSH_EDGE_PATH` 覆盖 |
| `userDataDir` | 按平台 | Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%`、macOS `~/Library/Application Support`、Linux `$XDG_STATE_HOME` 下的 `dsh-edge-browser/profile` |
| `headless` | `false` | 默认弹可见窗口 |
| `windowSize` | — | 例如 `1440,900` |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单个 CDP 操作默认超时 |
| `launchTimeoutMs` | `25000` | 等待调试端口就绪上限 |

## 自带测试

```powershell
node test/definitions.mjs      # 工具定义自检：不启动浏览器，秒级
node test/build-check.mjs      # 入口与依赖的模块身份是否都升到当前构建号
node test/smoke.mjs            # 端到端：真实启动 Edge 跑完整链路（需要非受限进程）
node test/live.mjs --url https://example.com   # 真实站点：HTTPS 导航 / 正文 / 截图
```

`definitions.mjs` 用假的 `ctx` 采集插件注册的 11 份 ToolDefinition，检查
参数/输出 schema、`render`、`execute`、命名唯一性，并验证"超时附带过期模块提示"。
它内置了 DSH 支持子集的复刻校验；要改用 DSH 自己的校验器：

```powershell
node test/definitions.mjs --validator <.../dsh-tools/lib/types/json-schema.js>
```

`smoke.mjs` 用与插件完全相同的 `lib/cdp.js` 跑一遍：启动 → 开标签 → 导航本地页面 →
读正文 → 执行 JS → 点击 → 输入 → 截图（PNG 视口/整页 + JPEG）→ 关标签。

`live.mjs` 打真实站点：HTTPS 导航（等 `readyState=complete`）、标题与正文提取、
页内 JS、视口/整页 PNG，并打印站点信息（协议、链接数、图片数、视口）。

> 注意：如果在受限沙箱（如 DSH 的 workspace-write 沙箱）里跑 `smoke.mjs`，Edge 的渲染进程
> 可能因受限令牌而崩溃（HTTP 端点正常、一连页面 WS 就 RST）。插件本身运行在不受限的
> Host 进程里，因此正常路径不受影响。

## 生效方式与热重载

- 安装后由 bundle 行 `edge-browser` 提供这 11 个工具；新会话立即可见。
- **改代码不必重启 DSH**。DSH 只热替换它监视目录下的模块，工作区里的 linked 包不在监视
  范围内，因此"同一个 specifier"永远不会被重新 import（改文件内容也没用）。本包用两条
  规则绕开它：
  1. **行名用相对 specifier** 指向按构建号命名的入口（`./lib/entry-<构建号>.js`）——
     Loader 对以 `.` 开头的名字按本 bundle 目录解析，新文件名 = 新的模块身份 = 必然重新 import；
  2. **入口内部用 `?b=<构建号>` 载入实现**（`plugin.js` / `cdp.js` / `ws.js`），
     让依赖也一起换身份，否则它们会命中旧模块缓存。
- 热重载步骤（四步，已实测）：

  ```
  1) 改 lib/*.js，把里面的 ?b= 升到新构建号，并同步 PLUGIN_BUILD
  2) 新入口文件 lib/entry-<新构建号>.js（内容一行：export * from './plugin.js?b=<新构建号>'）
  3) cordis.patch.yml 的行名改为 './lib/entry-<新构建号>.js'
  4) plugin_manager: set_bundle 关一次、再开一次（两次调用）
  ```

  然后 `edge_status` 会回报新的 `插件构建`，旧代际的插件被正常 dispose。
- **受限沙箱里跑不通**：如果在 DSH 的 workspace-write 沙箱内启动 Edge，浏览器进程的 HTTP
  端点正常，但渲染进程会因受限令牌崩溃（一连页面 WebSocket 就被 RST）。插件本身在宿主
  进程内运行，不受此影响；只有在受限 shell 里手工调 `lib/cdp.js` 时才会遇到。

## 验证状态

当前插件构建：**1.0.3**（`edge_status` 的 `pluginBuild` 字段会回报它）。

- **宿主进程内 11/11 工具实测通过**（真实 Edge 155，non-headless）：
  `edge_status`（探测到端口/版本/标签页）→ `edge_launch`（启动并 CDP 导航到本地验证页）→
  `edge_text`（正文提取）→ `edge_eval`（取 `window.__state`，并调用页内函数 `__sum([1,2,3,4])=10`）→
  `edge_click #counter`（计数 0→1，日志同步更新）→ `edge_type #q`（字段值写入）→
  `edge_screenshot`（整页 PNG 1241×1288 落盘，`read_image` 能看到点击/输入后的真实画面）→
  `edge_navigate https://example.com`（HTTPS 到 `readyState=complete`）→ `edge_text`（多语言正文）→
  `edge_open https://www.baidu.com`（标题「百度一下，你就知道」）→ `edge_tabs`（4 个标签页，
  当前页标记正确）→ `edge_close shutdown=true`（实例退出）。
- **工具定义 20/20 通过**（`test/definitions.mjs`）：11 份定义全部合法，其中参数与输出 schema
  通过 **DSH 自己的校验器**（`assertObjectJsonSchema` / `assertSupportedJsonSchema`，取自
  `dsh-tools/lib/types/json-schema.js`）——保证宿主注册时不会因 schema 失败而整行不激活。
- **端到端 17/17 通过**（`test/smoke.mjs`，非受限进程）：启动 → 开标签 → 导航本地页面 →
  `readyState=complete` → 正文 → 执行 JS（含 awaitPromise 返回 42）→ 按选择器点击（计数 0→1）→
  按可见文本点击 → 输入 → 回车提交 → 视口 PNG（756×488 校验）→ 整页截图落盘 → JPEG →
  关标签 → Browser.close。
- **真实站点 9/9 通过**（`test/live.mjs`，非受限进程）：
  - `https://example.com` → 标题 `Example Domain`、正文 917 字符、整页截图 741×713；
  - `https://www.baidu.com` → 标题 `百度一下，你就知道`、71 个链接 / 20 张图片、整页截图 741×696。
- **关闭时序已修**：`/json/close` 只表示"开始关闭"，目标会稍后才从列表消失；
  `edge_close` 现在等它真正消失（最多 2 秒）再报 `remaining`，测试也改成轮询断言。



## 卸载

```text
plugin_manager  remove_bundle  target=dsh-edge-browser
```

plugins.description: DSH 邮件通道插件：一台机器一个专属邮箱，邮件即会话入口，回复即续接上下文（零运行时依赖）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mail

给一台机器上的 DSH 配一个**专属邮箱**作为会话入口：邮件即会话，回复即续接上下文，答复自动回信，长任务可被打断。

- **纯出站**：IMAP 轮询收信 + SMTP 发信。机器不需要公网 IP，不开放任何入站端口，没有回调地址。
- **准入靠白名单**：只认 `From` 精确地址，其余一律丢弃，连回执都不发。
- **回复判定双保险**：`In-Reply-To`/`References` 优先，主题里的 `[dsh-xxxx]` 标签兜底。
- **零运行时依赖**：IMAP/SMTP 客户端与 MIME 解析都是本包自己实现的，只用 Node 内置模块。

设计取舍与逐条决策记录见 [docs/design-spec.md](docs/design-spec.md)。

## 仓库结构

```
src/                    插件本体（Host 插件，ESM）
  index.js              插件入口：Config、withDefaults、apply
  imap.js               IMAP 客户端（literal、IDLE、APPEND、互斥）
  smtp.js               SMTP 客户端（多行应答、AUTH、点填充）
  mime.js               MIME 解析：RFC 2047/2231、引文剥离、HTML 转文本
  inbound.js            入站判定：白名单、循环抑制、线程归属、提示渲染
  outgoing.js           出站组装：主题标签、线程信头、MIME 与附件
  session.js            会话控制器适配（投递、打断、取结果）
  store.js              原子状态库（messages / threads / cursor）
test/                   全部离线测试（node:test）
tools/                  对真实邮箱的只读自检脚本
docs/design-spec.md     设计规格 v1
cordis.patch.yml        插件自带的 bundle 补丁（只含中性默认值）
```

## 状态

已实现并在离线仿真中验证：白名单准入、循环邮件抑制、新会话/续接判定、受理回执、结果回信、**同线程回复打断当前轮次**、附件落工作区、崩溃重放、Sent 文件夹回写。

未实现（按约定属于后续阶段）：基于 plan todo 的阶段汇报、权限清单与超范围询问。

## 安装

插件是标准的 DSH Host 插件包（ESM，导出 `name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply`），同时是一个
**bundle**：它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责往 profile 里插入插件行。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/secondlgn/dsh-mail
```

然后在你的 profile 目录（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/`）里做两处改动：

```jsonc
// <profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    // 二选一：指向本地克隆，或用 GitHub 源
    "dsh-mail": "file:C:/path/to/dsh-mail",
    // "dsh-mail": "github:secondlgn/dsh-mail"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-mail"]
    }
  }
}
```

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
# 注意：这里【不能】写 name: 字段。带 name 的条目是「插入新行」的写法，而新行必须由
# bundle 提供；在 profile 补丁里带 name 会被当作未匹配条目静默忽略，插件永远不会加载。
# 这里只能按 id 覆盖配置。
- id: dsh-mail
  config:
    enabled: true
    imap:
      host: imap.example.com
      port: 993
      user: agent@example.com
      passwordEnv: DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD
    smtp:
      host: smtp.example.com
      port: 465
      user: agent@example.com
    allowFrom:
      - you@example.com
    workspaceDir: C:/work
```

`bundles` 里必须加上 `dsh-mail`，它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 才会被插入；那里面只有中性默认值
（`enabled: false`），真正的账号与白名单写在上面的 profile 补丁里。补丁会**整体替换**该行的
`config`，所以上面这份配置要写全，不能只写增量。

密码**不要写进配置**：用 `passwordEnv`（默认 `DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD`）指向环境变量。

`allowFrom` 为空时**任何人都无法驱动这台机器**——这是安全的默认值，不是 bug。

### 关于 workspaceDir

`workspaceDir` 决定邮箱会话的工作目录，**每台机器不同，不要照抄**。留空则用当前工作目录。
它必须是该机器上真实存在的绝对路径。

### 界面配置：暂时不可用

浏览器半侧（`lib/client.js`）仍在仓库里，它会在侧栏的插件页注册一张「邮件通道」卡片，但**目前不要指望它能用**。

原因是一个被证伪的前提：DSH 的设置服务只能编辑 schema 上用 `.volatile()` 声明的字段，而
**运行时解析到的 schemastery 是 3.18.1，其中 `Schema.prototype.volatile` 根本不存在**：

```
$ node -e "…require('@deepseek-ai/schemastery')…console.log(typeof z.boolean().volatile)"
undefined
```

（`app.asar` 内附的源码副本是 3.18.4、有 `.volatile()`，这正是我当初误判的来源——我读了随包源码，
却没有验证运行时实际解析到的版本。）

在 schema 上声明 `.volatile()` 会在构造 Config 时抛 `TypeError`，插件行**整个起不来**，表现为
「插件开着但邮件完全不被处理」。因此这些声明已全部回退，配置恢复为普通字段。

没有 volatile，设置服务就不会为该条目投影出任何表单字段，页面拿不到可编辑状态。要让界面配置复活，
需要先解决版本问题（升级运行时的 schemastery，或让 DSH 的设置服务支持非 volatile 字段）。

**在此之前，请直接改 `cordis.patch.yml`**（见上面的配置示例）；改完重启 DSH 生效。

`stateDir` 与 `dshHome` 即使将来能编辑也应留在文件里：它们决定状态库的位置，运行时改动会让通道与
自己的历史脱钩。

### 验证安装

重启 DSH 后，插件行应以 `include:dsh-mail` 出现且状态为 `active`。若没出现，按顺序检查：

1. `bundles` 里是否真的加了 `dsh-mail`；
2. profile 补丁里是否误写了 `name:`（见上面的警告）；
3. `package.json` 是否为合法 JSON。

### 网易邮箱（163/126/yeah）必读

网易对第三方客户端有额外要求，插件已经内置处理，但值得知道原因：

- **登录后必须先发 `ID` 命令**（RFC 2971）声明客户端身份，否则 `SELECT INBOX` 会直接返回
  `NO [Unsafe Login]`。插件在 `CAPABILITY` 里看到 `ID` 就自动发送。
- **Sent 文件夹名为 modified UTF-7**（163 上是 `&XfJT0ZAB-`，即「已发送」）。插件靠 RFC 6154 的
  `\Sent` 属性识别它，不依赖名字，所以不需要手工配置 `sentMailbox`。
- 首次接入建议先在邮箱设置里开启 **IMAP/SMTP 服务**，并使用**授权码**而不是登录密码。

参考配置（同样是**不带 `name:`** 的 id 覆盖）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-mail
  config:
    enabled: true
    imap:
      host: imap.163.com
      port: 993
      user: you@163.com
      passwordEnv: DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD
    smtp:
      host: smtp.163.com
      port: 465
      user: you@163.com
      passwordEnv: DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD
    allowFrom: [you@163.com]
```

### 上线前自检

仓库 `tools/` 里有两个只读检查脚本，在仓库根目录运行（都需要 `DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD` 可见）：

```sh
node tools/mail-probe.mjs     you@163.com   # 登录 + 能力 + Sent 文件夹识别
node tools/mail-rehearsal.mjs you@163.com   # 抓最新几封真实邮件跑一遍判定与解析
```

两者都**不发信、不写状态、不标记已读**，可以在启用插件前对着真实邮箱放心跑。

## 配置项

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉后插件不建立任何连接 |
| `imap.host` / `imap.user` | 必填 | IMAP 服务器与账号 |
| `imap.port` / `imap.secure` | `993` / `true` | 隐式 TLS |
| `imap.password` / `imap.passwordEnv` | `''` / `DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD` | 密码内联或环境变量名 |
| `imap.mailbox` | `INBOX` | 轮询的文件夹 |
| `imap.sentMailbox` | `''` | 留空则自动识别 `\Sent`，再按常见名称兜底 |
| `imap.pollIntervalMs` | `20000` | 轮询间隔（有效下限 2000），`IDLE` 不可用时按它轮询 |
| `imap.idle` | `true` | 首选 `IDLE`，不可用时自动退回轮询 |
| `imap.maxIdleMs` | `240000` | 单次 `IDLE` 的最长等待上限 |
| `imap.rejectUnauthorized` | `true` | 关掉即不校验 IMAP 服务器证书（仅用于自签调试） |
| `smtp.host` | 同 `imap.host` | 留空即复用 IMAP 主机 |
| `smtp.port` / `smtp.secure` | `465` / `true` | 提交端口 |
| `smtp.password` / `smtp.passwordEnv` | `''` / `DSH_MAIL_PASSWORD` | 留空则复用 IMAP 的密码解析结果 |
| `smtp.saveToSent` | `true` | 发信后回写 Sent 文件夹 |
| `smtp.rejectUnauthorized` | `true` | 关掉即不校验 SMTP 服务器证书（仅用于自签调试） |
| `allowFrom` | `[]` | 允许驱动 agent 的发件人地址（精确匹配） |
| `selfAddresses` | `[]` | 额外视为「自己」的地址，用于自环检测 |
| `fromName` | `DSH Agent` | 发信显示名 |
| `tagPrefix` | `[dsh-` | 主题标签前缀 |
| `workspaceDir` | `process.cwd()` | 新建会话的工作目录 |
| `agentPreset` | `''` | 邮箱会话使用的 agent 预设，留空用 profile 默认 |
| `stateDir` | `<DSH_HOME>/mail` | 插件状态目录 |
| `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME` | 覆盖状态目录推导所用的 DSH 主目录 |
| `sendReceipt` | `true` | 受理后立即回执 |
| `sendResult` | `true` | 轮次结束后回结果 |
| `includeModePreamble` | `true` | 在提示里注入邮件排版要求 |
| `interruptSameThread` | `true` | 同线程回复打断正在跑的轮次 |
| `maxMessageBytes` | 32 MiB | 超过则丢弃 |
| `maxResultChars` | `60000` | 回信正文上限，超出截断并标注 |
| `attachments.enabled` | `true` | 是否落盘附件 |
| `attachments.maxBytes` / `maxCount` | 10 MiB / 10 | 单附件与数量上限 |
| `attachments.dir` | `<workspace>/.dsh-mail/attachments` | 附件根目录 |
| `recovery` | `rerun` | 崩溃恢复：`rerun` 重跑未完成的信，其他值标记失败 |

## 工作方式

### 会话判定

```
1. From 在白名单？              否 → 丢弃（不记录、不回信）
2. 自动回复 / 群发 / 邮件列表？ 是 → 丢弃
3. Message-ID 已处理完？        是 → 丢弃
4. In-Reply-To/References → 我方 Message-ID → 命中线程标签
   主题里的 [dsh-xxxx] → 命中线程标签
   都没有 → 新建会话（旧线程若断了，就是新会话）
```

### 打断语义（关键行为）

**只有回复属于「正在运行的那个会话」时才打断。** 别的会话的来信只排队，不打扰当前轮次。

打断的实现是「先投递、再取消」：把新内容以 `queue` 投进会话，然后 `cancel` 掉当前轮次，让队列里的新提示立刻接管。`steer` 可用时优先用它。

### 投递保证

**至少一次**。进程在「已投递」与「记为完成」之间崩溃时会重放——重复回答比漏信便宜。为控制代价，重放前先读 `state.json` 里记录的原会话与收件人，不会因为线程映射变化而走错会话；同一线程的同一段文本也不会重复发送。

### 回执与回信

| 邮件 | 时机 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 受理回执 | 通过准入后立即 | `已收到（回执 xxxxxx），会话 [dsh-xxxx]，开始处理` |
| 结果回信 | 轮次结束 | 该轮的助手文本；未完成/被取消的轮次不发 |

回执的意义是让你**在第一封信里就拿到会话号**：之后就算客户端丢了 `References`，只要主题里的 `[dsh-xxxx]` 还在，就能续接。

`turn/end` 原因为 `interrupted` 或 `forked` 时不发结果，避免把被打断的半成品当成答复。

### 邮件模式提示

入站内容会包一层元信息送进模型，说明这是邮件而非对话框、只输出纯文本、控制行宽、不要提实现细节、不要复述提示本身，并附上发件人、主题、会话号、回执号。

## 状态文件

```
<stateDir>/
  messages.json   Message-ID → { 发件人, 主题, 正文, 会话, 线程标签, 回执号, 阶段, 时间 }
  threads.json    线程标签 ↔ 会话，以及我方发出的 Message-ID
  cursor.json     轮询水位（UID + UIDVALIDITY）
```

写入是原子的（临时文件 + fsync + rename），并按文件串行化。`UIDVALIDITY` 变化会重置 UID 水位，但消息身份始终由 Message-ID 决定，所以重置不会重放已完成的信。

## 开发

```sh
npm test                    # node --test，自动发现 test/*.test.mjs
npm run test:single-process # 沙箱下的退路：不用按文件子进程隔离
```

零依赖，`npm install` 不是必需的。用 DSH 自带的 Node 跑也一样（自带 TLS 与 `node:test`）：

```sh
"C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node.exe" --test
```

默认的按文件子进程隔离在某些文件沙箱下会以 `EPERM` 失败，这时改用 `npm run test:single-process`
（把全部用例放进一个进程）。

测试全部离线：真实 TLS 连接（自签证书在进程内生成）对接脚本化的 IMAP/SMTP 服务器，加一个 Host 会话控制器桩。`DSH_MAIL_TEST_TRACE=1` 会打印插件自身的日志。

| 文件 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|
| `test/mime.test.mjs` | RFC 2047、GBK/UTF-8、引文剥离、HTML 转文本、附件识别 |
| `test/inbound.test.mjs` | 白名单、循环抑制、新会话/续接、重复与重放判定 |
| `test/store.test.mjs` | 原子写入、并发修改、水位语义、保留策略 |
| `test/imap.test.mjs` | 协议解析、literal（含多次写入与多 literal）、互斥、IDLE、APPEND |
| `test/smtp.test.mjs` | 多行应答、AUTH 三

plugins.description: Starts every newly created DeepSeek Harness session in the built-in Auto review permission preset instead of the configured default preset.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-review-default

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

把会话放进内置的 `auto` 权限预设（Auto review）：**新建会话在创建时进入**，**已有的根会话在重新打开（恢复）时切过去**。

委托给子代理产生的子会话不会被改动——它们的权限由父会话的委派固定，而且 Auto 的 `ask` 策略会让子会话的审批在委派过程中弹给人。

## 它解决什么

DSH 官方有意不让 Auto 成为默认值，两处文档原文：

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`：「**Auto 不能成为默认值**——它只在 integration effect 存活期间存在，并且有意不进入 `permission` 设置 schema。」
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-permission-presets`：「设置行……`auto` 等仅限当前会话的 contribution 不会出现」「**Auto review 仅限当前会话**」。

结果是通用设置的权限下拉永远只有配置表里的预设，Auto 必须一个一个会话手动切（输入框的权限控件，或 `/permission auto`）。

安装前必须已有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`（官方随附的实验层）；它在启用状态时本插件才有可切换的目标。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default
```

把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名（DSH Desktop 用的是 `desktop`）。装完宿主会热加载，不必重启。

## 它怎么工作

宿主里唯一决定「会话初始权限」的地方是 `PermissionPresetService#pinInitialPermission(session)`：服务自己的 `session/created` 监听器**对每一个进入 store 的会话**都调它（新建的、恢复的都算），挂载时还会对存量会话各调一次。本插件只包这一个方法：调用原方法之后，若该会话不是委托子会话且当前不在 `auto`，就经官方 `permissionPresets.set` 切到 `auto`。挂在同一个方法上才能在原方法写入任何事件**之前**读到 `session.seq === 0`，从而区分「新建」与「恢复」（只影响日志措辞，采纳与否不依赖它）。

这确实是对宿主内部方法的包装，不是官方扩展点；取舍见下方「已知限制」。

**装载时已经活着的会话故意不动**：插件只在「创建」与「恢复」两个时点动作，所以你正开着的会话会保留它当前的预设，直到它被重新打开。

## 安全性质

- **永不抛出**。`session/created` 里的同步异常会否决并回滚会话创建，所以这里任何失败都降级为「保持会话当前预设」，只写一行警告日志。
- **不碰委托子会话**：`dsh-subagent` 会给子会话打 `origin: "subagent"` 与正的 `delegationDepth`（根会话持久化后是 `delegationDepth: 0`，所以只有正数才算子会话）。header 读不出来时一律当作子会话处理，不做猜测。
- **不碰定时任务运行器的会话**：`@michengai/dsh-automation` 的运行会话 id 以 `dsh-automation-session-` 开头，任务创建时自带无人值守预设（通常 `approval: never`），切到 Auto 会把每一步都变成无人应答的授权弹窗（v0.2.0 的实际事故，v0.2.1 修复）。
- **幂等**，并通过 Cordis effect 的 disposer 可逆；在 Auto 不可用（实验层未启用）时自动降级。

## 验证记录

在隔离的 `headless` profile 里用一次性任务实测，读会话投影缓存的 `permissions` 值：

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 装插件后新建会话 | `preset: "auto"`（sandbox `danger-full-access` + approval `ask`） |
| 不装插件新建会话（基线） | `preset: "workspace-write"` |
| **装插件后恢复那个基线会话** | **`preset: "auto"`**（恢复时切换） |
| 模型起子代理产生的子会话 | 插件未采纳（探针实测 `isChild=true` 被拦下）；子会话上的 `permission/preset auto` 是 `dsh-subagent` 自己把父会话预设拷进去的 |
| `dsh-automation-session-*` 运行会话 | 插件不采纳，保持任务自带的无人值守预设（v0.2.1） |

在 DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-review-default
```

## 已知限制

- **恢复旧会话时会一律切到 Auto**，包括你曾经显式设成「仅可查看」或「工作区内修改文件」的会话——它会把沙箱放宽到 `danger-full-access`（同时加上逐调用审查）。这是有意的选择，不是副作用；如果你只希望新会话走 Auto，就别装这个插件，或者把 `adopt()` 里的判定收窄。
- **Auto 是实验功能**：可能误放行不安全动作、误拒有用操作，并让每次工具调用多一次模型请求（不缓存、不重试）。本插件只把它设成默认，不改变它的行为。
- **包装的是宿主内部方法名**。DSH 升级若重命名 `pinInitialPermission`，插件会**静默失效**（会话保持各自当前预设），不会报错也不会弄坏启动。升级后若发现新会话不再进 Auto，先查这里。
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 处于启用状态；它缺失时本插件自动降级。
- 不做按工作区或按 Agent 的细分规则；要那种粒度请用 [`dsh-workspace-tools`](https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools)（但它目前只允许三个内置预设，不含 `auto`）。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 提示词输入框右下角加一个润色按钮：一键让模型改写草稿，润色用的提示词可随时修改
plugins.readme_text:
# 提示词润色 · dsh-plugin-prompt-polish

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的提示词输入框加一个**润色按钮**：写好草稿后点一下，模型把它改写成更清晰、更完整的提示词，直接替换回输入框。润色用的提示词（system prompt）**随时可以自己改**，不写死。

```
┌─ 输入框 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 帮我弄个插件 加个按钮 润色                                  │
│                                                            │
│                [ ✨润色 ] [ ↻撤销 ] [ ⚙设置 ]   [模型] [发送] │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 功能

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点 **✨ 润色** | 把当前草稿交给模型改写，成功后整段替换回输入框 |
| 点 **↻ 撤销** | 把润色前的原文写回去（只在草稿没被你再改过时出现） |
| 点 **⚙ 设置** | 打开设置面板，修改「润色用的提示词」，可一键恢复默认 |
| 输入框为空 | 按钮置灰 |
| 正在提交 | 按钮置灰 |
| 润色中 | 图标转圈，按钮禁用 |

润色是**一次性补全**：借用你当前的默认模型，但不会写进任何会话历史，所以不污染上下文，也不影响 KV 缓存。

真实效果示例：

> 输入：`帮我弄个插件，在输入框那加个按钮，点了能润色我写的东西，还要能改润色用的提示词`
>
> 输出：
> ```
> 帮我实现一个插件，在输入框那里加一个按钮。
>
> **目标**
> 1. 在输入框区域添加一个按钮。
> 2. 点击该按钮后，对我在输入框里写的内容进行润色。
> 3. 润色所用的提示词要可以修改，我需要能自己改。
>
> **验收标准**
> - 输入框处能看到并点击这个按钮。
> - 点击后能对我输入的内容执行润色。
> - 能修改润色使用的提示词，并且改完之后生效。
> ```

## 安装

### 方式一：从插件界面安装（推荐）

1. 打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**
2. 填入仓库地址：`https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish`
3. 安装 → 启用 → **重启 DSH**

### 方式二：命令行手动安装

```bash
# 1) 装进目标 profile（profile 名以你自己的为准，例如 desktop / web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish

# 2) 让这个包的分层生效：把它加进 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles
#    编辑 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json → dsh.profile.bundles 追加：
#    "dsh-plugin-prompt-polish"
```

> `dsh plugin add` 只是 pnpm 的薄包装，**不会**替你改 `dsh.profile.bundles`，第 2 步必须手动做。

### 方式三：从本地目录安装（开发用）

在插件界面里直接填本机目录的绝对路径，或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
```

> **装完必须重启一次 DSH。**
> 原因是 DSH 的插件加载器对已经导入过的模块会命中 Node 的 ESM 缓存：在运行中开关插件条目**不会**重新导入改动后的代码（实测如此）。重启后输入框右下角就会出现按钮。

卸载：在「设置 → 插件」里关掉或卸载，或删掉 profile `package.json` 里的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目。

## 修改润色提示词

点输入框右下角的 **⚙**，直接编辑保存；想还原就点「恢复默认」。

也可以直接改文件（改完立即生效，不需要重启）：

```
$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/prompt-polish/settings.json     # {"prompt": "……"}
$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/prompt-polish/status.json       # 加载自检 / 报错记录
```

`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，也可以用环境变量 `DSH_HOME` 或 `DSH_PROMPT_POLISH_SETTINGS` 指定。
删掉 `settings.json` 就回到内置默认提示词。

内置默认提示词要求模型：只输出润色结果、不执行任务、保持原意与语言、逐字保留 `@文件引用`/代码/命令/路径/URL、补全结构但不臆造事实。

## 可选：换模型或调参数

默认跟随你的默认模型。想让润色更快，可以在 profile 补丁（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖：

```yaml
- id: prompt-polish
  config:
    provider: deepseek-account
    model: deepseek-flash
    reasoningEffort: low     # 不填则用该模型默认档位
    temperature: 0.3         # 默认 0.3
    maxTokens: 2048          # 默认 2048
```

## 工作原理

```
浏览器半 lib/client.js                      Host 半 lib/host.mjs
┌──────────────────────────┐               ┌────────────────────────────────┐
│ conversation.input.right │  HTTP POST    │ /dsh-prompt-polish/<endpoint>  │
│  ✨ / ↻ / ⚙ 三个按钮       │ ───────────▶  │  connection.admit() 鉴权        │
│  useInput 读草稿          │               │  ctx.llm.stream() 调模型        │
│  setDraft 写回草稿        │ ◀─────────── │  设置读写 JSON 文件              │
└──────────────────────────┘  信封响应      └────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **Host 半**在本机 HTTP 服务上挂一条 `/dsh-prompt-polish` 前缀路由，端点：`polish` / `getSettings` / `saveSettings` / `resetSettings`。线路协议与 DSH 通用 RPC 完全一致（`client-request` / `server-response` 信封），因此浏览器半直接复用 `ctx.connection.rpc.call()`，**无需任何代码生成**。文件只依赖 Node 内置模块，从任意本地目录加载都不需要 node_modules。
- **浏览器半**注册到 `conversation.input.right` 槽位，只依赖 DSH 的**平台种子模块**（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），所以是自包含的手写产物，不需要打包工具。草稿通过槽位自动注入的 `useInput` 读、`inputActions.setDraft` 写；写回前用 `draftRev` 做一次 CAS，避免覆盖你在等待期间的编辑。

### 两个实现要点（踩过的坑）

1. **`ctx.effect` 的回调必须返回 disposer 函数。** 返回 Promise 会被 Cordis 判为非法并回滚整个作用域，已经注册好的路由会静默消失。
2. **没有使用 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle()`。** 在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上这条 API 实际不可用：它内部用 owner 作用域去取 `webServer`，会抛 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`，而 `handle()` 本身不报错、路由也不会出现（全仓库没有任何官方调用者）。因此这里改用公开且可用的 `webServer.register()` 挂路由 + `connection.admit()` 做鉴权，行为与官方通道一致。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
cd dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
npm test
```

**28 项测试，不需要启动 DSH**（`node:test`，零依赖）：

- **Host 半**：装配契约（依赖注入、路由形状、disposer 契约）、HTTP 层（404 / 401 / 415 / 信封不匹配）、设置端点往返、润色端点（提示词拼装、代码块围栏清理、分片拼接、`finish=error`、抛错包装、空草稿短路）。
- **浏览器半**：用自制的微型 React hook 运行时把组件真跑起来，从元素树里找到按钮并**触发点击**，断言「结果写回草稿」「空草稿只提示不调用」「润色期间草稿被改过则不覆盖（draftRev CAS）」「失败走 error 提示通道」「撤销写回原文」「提交中禁用」「图标用的是星形闪光」。

```
dsh-plugin-prompt-polish/
├── package.json          # 双半声明：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 组合层：把 Host 半作为一个 entry 插入 profile
├── icon.svg              # 插件卡片图标
├── locale/{zh,en}.json   # 插件卡片标题 / 描述
├── lib/host.mjs          # Host 半：HTTP 通道 + 调模型 + 读写设置
├── lib/client.js         # 浏览器半：输入框按钮 + 设置面板
└── test/                 # 单元测试
```

## 已知限制

- 草稿里如果带 `@文件` 引用芯片，整段替换会丢失芯片（LLM 改写本来也会破坏引用语义）；如果担心，先复制一份原文。
- 润色质量取决于「润色提示词」和所用模型；`reasoningEffort` 默认跟随模型档位，想更快可在配置里指定 `low`。
- 一次润色 = 一次模型调用，会消耗你自己的用量。
- 插件安装后 DSH 暂不支持自动更新，升级请先卸载再装新版。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: dsh-webhook-dispatcher gives a dsh deployment inbound webhook dispatch: when an HTTP caller reaches one of the plugin's endpoints, a fresh, isolated agent session handles the delivered content.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webhook-dispatcher

dsh-webhook-dispatcher gives a dsh deployment inbound webhook dispatch: when
an HTTP caller reaches one of the plugin's endpoints, a fresh, isolated agent
session handles the delivered content. External systems such as CI pipelines,
issue trackers, or monitoring tools can drive dsh sessions directly - no
per-service bridge code.

- Endpoints are exact routes on the profile's webServer service (the Web GUI
  server in the web profile; other profiles compose
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver - see Cross-profile deployment); external
  reachability is the operator's reverse-proxy decision
- Per-endpoint configuration: identity (id / path / name), token auth, policy
  text, working directory, sandbox, model, reasoning effort, and resource limits
- Each admitted delivery spawns a fresh agent session; per-endpoint
  concurrency and queue caps, with `429` + `Retry-After` backpressure
- A single `webhook status` tool verb reports live routes, queue depth, and
  recent delivery history; the plugin creates no config files
- Session offload: a per-minute sweep archives settled trigger sessions that
  outlived the endpoint's `sessionRetention` window, keeping the framework
  session store bounded

## Installation

dsh-webhook-dispatcher is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it
with the dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-webhook-dispatcher
```

Configure endpoints through the `WEBHOOK_*` env block and/or the cordis
config layer (see Configuration).

## Cross-profile deployment

Endpoints register as exact routes on the profile's `webServer` service. The
`web` profile provides it through the Web GUI server; every other profile
(`sdk`, `acp`, a custom bundle) must compose a `webServer` provider into its
own composition - the framework's route server
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` (see its own docs). One-shot surfaces such
as `headless` cannot host a resident listener, so they cannot host this plugin:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml (example)
- insert:
    - id: webserver
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver'
      config:
        host: <host>
        port: <port>  # a free fixed port; port 0 re-resolves the bound address on every restart
```

## Configuration

Endpoints are configured through two equal channels that fold onto one
contract: the `WEBHOOK_*` env block (read once at process boot) and the
cordis config layer (the profile/user `cordis.patch.yml` entry targeting the
plugin id `dsh-webhook-dispatcher`; hot - a patch change re-constructs the
plugin entry, which re-reads both channels). Precedence per field: config
layer > env > built-in defaults.

### Config layer

```yaml
- id: dsh-webhook-dispatcher
  config:
    endpoints:
      - id: <name>
        path: /<path>
        policy: "Treat the content as a task description and act on it."
        # name: <name>           (default: the id)
        # cwd: /abs/path         (default: $DSH_HOME/dsh-webhook-dispatcher)
        # auth: <TOKEN_ENV>           (env var NAME holding the token value; empty = open endpoint)
        # sandbox: workspace-write    (read-only | workspace-write | danger-full-access)
        # model: some/model           (default: the default selection ladder)
        # reasoningEffort: low        (closed set off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max; absent: the framework provider default)
        # maxConcurrent: 1            (default)
        # maxQueue: 100               (default)
        # maxBodyBytes: 262144        (default)
        # sessionRetention: 24h       (session offload window; absent/0 = retain in the store)
```

Unknown keys are rejected (a typo guard); `path` must not collide with a
framework-owned route.

### Env contract

The same endpoint shape as `WEBHOOK_<ENDPOINT_ID>_<FIELD>` variables:

```sh
WEBHOOK_<NAME>_PATH=/<path>
WEBHOOK_<NAME>_POLICY="Treat the content as a task description and act on it."
WEBHOOK_<NAME>_AUTH=<TOKEN_ENV>   # the NAME of the env holding the token value
WEBHOOK_<NAME>_MODEL=some/model
WEBHOOK_<NAME>_REASONING_EFFORT=low
<TOKEN_ENV>=...
```

| field | env suffix | built-in default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` (required) | `PATH` | - |
| `name` | `NAME` | the id |
| `policy` | `POLICY` | empty (free-policy fallback) |
| `cwd` | `CWD` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-webhook-dispatcher` |
| `auth` | `AUTH` | empty (open endpoint) |
| `sandbox` | `SANDBOX` | the session default |
| `model` | `MODEL` | the default selection ladder |
| `reasoningEffort` | `REASONING_EFFORT` | the framework provider default (closed set off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max, validated at boot) |
| `maxConcurrent` | `MAX_CONCURRENT` | 1 |
| `maxQueue` | `MAX_QUEUE` | 100 |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | 262144 |
| `sessionRetention` | `SESSION_RETENTION` | absent (retain in the store) |

- The id segment is the endpoint id uppercased with hyphens written as
  underscores (`ci-run` -> `WEBHOOK_CI_RUN_*`)
- Both channels share one validator: a declaration without `PATH`, an
  out-of-bounds value, or a declared `AUTH` name that is not set fails the
  plugin at boot (fail-closed, the config layer's posture)
- A declared token env produces no warning; any other mistyped
  `WEBHOOK_` variable warns at boot

## Tool

`webhook { verb: "status" }` - the live endpoint state, the recent-delivery
ring, and the effective (non-secret) endpoint config. See the
`dsh-webhook-dispatcher` skill for the full reference.

## Session offload

Webhook dispatches leave on-disk session logs in the framework session store;
at delivery volume (frequent or chatty endpoints) the store grows without
bound. The per-minute offload sweep archives settled trigger sessions once
their endpoint's `sessionRetention` window elapses, so the store stays
bounded: the store is never deleted, only moved, and a session that is still
running is kept until it settles.

- **Windows**: `sessionRetention` is per-endpoint (the config layer's
  `sessionRetention` field or the env
  `WEBHOOK_<ID>_SESSION_RETENTION`): a non-negative integer number of
  milliseconds, or a duration string of 1-2 digits+unit segments (units
  d/h/m/s/ms) in descending order (e.g. `24h`, `4h30m`, `90s`, `5000ms`;
  a bare numeric string is invalid). 0 / absent = retain (no offload); an
  invalid value warns and is treated as 0 (never a boot failure).
- **Budget**: `WEBHOOK_OFFLOAD_BATCH` (env, default 50) bounds the
  sessions one sweep may process; an invalid value warns and falls back to
  50, never disabling the sweep. When consecutive sweeps observe new log
  lines arriving faster than the budget, the sweep logs a trend warning
  (raise the knob or lower the retention windows; the warning takes no
  action on its own).
- **Failure semantics**: an unreachable persistence service, a missing store
  root, or an archive on a different mount disables the sweep for that round
  (a visible warning; log lines are never lost); a failed individual move is
  retried next round.

The offload state (retention log `retention-log.jsonl`, archive
`archived-sessions/`, and the default trigger-session workspace) lives under
the plugin home `$DSH_HOME/dsh-webhook-dispatcher/`. The selftest covers the
offload plane as well (window parsing, retention-log mechanics, the sweep's
window/liveness/budget/trend semantics, the dispatch write gate, the archive
move, and the layout pin).

## Development

```
pnpm install     # peers resolve from the registry (onboarding .npmrc / pnpm-workspace.yaml)
pnpm run build   # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run lint    # eslint over src/ and test/
pnpm run selftest
```

Peer resolution is a deliberate dev/staged pair: the dev tree keeps
`autoInstallPeers: true` so the peer closure resolves from the package's own
`node_modules` (needed for the in-tree typecheck); the staged deployment tree
ships `autoInstallPeers: false` plus `.npmrc legacy-peer-deps=true`, so peers
resolve from the enclosing plugin tree of the deployment, like every
neighbor plugin.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ollama-quota

DeepSeek Harness plugin that owns the **provider quota dock** at the sidebar foot: Ollama
Cloud credit, ChatGPT **Codex subscription quota**, and the **DeepSeek API balance** with its
peak/off-peak price phase. One package, one off-peak engine, one `sidebar.footer.action` cell
that shows every provider on one line and opens into their full cards, plus the Ollama Settings
section that carries the full rule, the usage report, and the API key editor.

The package name and the Ollama card predate the merge; the cards themselves are independent,
so one provider can be read without the others (see [Configuration](#configuration)).

Ollama moved the account to a credit model: `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage` no longer
carries the old `limits.session` / `limits.weekly` windows (it answers a
`range`/`totals`/`buckets` report instead), so readers built on that shape fail with
**"Could not parse the response · no limits object"**. The remaining credit now comes from
`GET https://ollama.com/api/balance`, which is what this plugin reads.

## Data sources

| Provider | Endpoint | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ollama Cloud | `GET https://ollama.com/api/balance` | primary: `included.balance_usd`, `included.allowance_usd`, `included.period`, `purchased.balance_usd` |
| Ollama Cloud | `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage?range=24h\|7d\|30d` | advisory: `totals` (cost, requests, tokens) and daily `buckets` |
| DeepSeek | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | `is_available` plus one `balance_infos` entry per currency, split into `granted_balance` and `topped_up_balance` |
| Codex | `POST /api/codex-subscription/usage` | the subscription plugin's own quota channel, called from the page over the Connection |

Ollama endpoints take `Authorization: Bearer <Ollama Cloud key>`; DeepSeek takes the same with
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. A failure on the Ollama usage report never hides a healthy balance; it
renders as an inline note inside the usage card. The usage report is re-read on its own slower
interval (`usageRefreshMs`) because its wide window barely moves.

The Codex card never touches the ChatGPT OAuth grant: it reuses the channel
`dsh-codex-subscription` publishes for its own UI, so the quota it shows is the same number that
plugin would show, and the grant and its refresh stay owned by that plugin. Its only coupling is
that channel's name and payload shape (verified against `dsh-codex-subscription` 2.5.9).

## What it shows

| Row | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Remaining included credit | `included.balance_usd` of `included.allowance_usd` |
| Used share bar | `allowance - balance` over `allowance` |
| Purchased credit | `purchased.balance_usd` |
| Allowance period | `included.period.from` → `included.period.until` |
| Spend, requests, input/cached/output tokens | `usage.totals` over `usageRange` |
| Daily spend strip | `usage.buckets[].usage_usd` (max 31 buckets) |
| Off-peak state and countdown | computed from the browser clock: peak pricing runs weekdays 12:00–18:00 UTC, everything else is off-peak |
| Key source | which credential reference resolved |
| API key editor | `remote.credentials.describe(refs)` / `set(ref, value)` / `unset(ref)` over the DSH Remote (`remote.credentials` is a declared inject edge) |

Per-model request counts are not shown: the endpoint stopped reporting them.

### Sidebar widget

The plugin registers **one** `sidebar.footer.action` cell: a single line that stays visible at all
times, not only while Settings is open. Collapsed, it lines up every provider on one row — a
brand-coloured mark, an optional rate-phase dot, and one number each — so the state is readable
without opening anything. There is no phase text: **green dot = off-peak, red dot = peak**.

| Tile | Shows while collapsed | Title (hover) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ollama | remaining included credit, plus the phase dot | remaining, phase, countdown to the next boundary |
| Codex | the highest used share of the subscription windows | the provider name |
| DeepSeek | total balance, plus its own phase dot | the provider name and its phase |

Pressing the row expands it in place into the full per-provider cards: the Ollama card (remaining
credit, the 30-day spend, phase countdown, the 24h strip on the **browser's local clock**), the
Codex card (each window's meter, reset credits, reset countdown) and the DeepSeek card (top-up vs
granted credit, its own peak/off-peak phase and strip). Pressing it again collapses the row.

The marks are drawn inline (a letter in the provider's colour) so the bundle stays a single classic
script with no image assets.

The collapsed 56px rail keeps the credit and a compact `H:MM` countdown.

Ollama applies off-peak pricing outside 12:00–18:00 UTC on weekdays and all day at weekends, so
the peak window is the only interval whose end is a peak start.

The Settings section carries the same state as an additional card with the full rule text, the
local peak window, the current local time, and both countdowns.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/okku000/dsh-ollama-quota.git
```

While developing against a checkout, link the directory instead so edits are live:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-ollama-quota
```

A Host change needs an application restart; the Client half needs a page refresh.

## Configuration

The row reads these fields, all optional (`cordis.patch.yml`):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `keyEnvs` | `[OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY, OLLAMA_API_KEY]` | credential references tried in order; the first is what the editor writes |
| `apiBase` | `https://ollama.com` | API origin |
| `usageRange` | `30d` | usage window, one of `24h`, `7d`, `30d` |
| `refreshMs` | `60000` | balance refresh interval, minimum `5000` |
| `usageRefreshMs` | `300000` | usage-report interval, minimum `60000`; `?force=1` or a new key re-reads it |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | per-request timeout |
| `deepseek.keyEnvs` | `[DEEPSEEK_API_KEY]` | DeepSeek credential references tried in order |
| `deepseek.apiBase` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | DeepSeek API origin |
| `deepseek.refreshMs` | `60000` | how long one DeepSeek balance read is reused (15000–3600000) |
| `deepseek.timeoutMs` | `15000` | DeepSeek per-request timeout |
| `deepseek.offPeak` | published schedule | `enabled`, `discountPercent`, `holidayTimeZone`, `peakWindows` (`{ days: [1-7], from: 'HH:MM', to: 'HH:MM' }`, UTC), `holidays` (`{ from: 'YYYY-MM-DD', to: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }`) |

The Host half serves `GET /ollama-quota/snapshot` for the Ollama card and
`GET /ollama-quota/deepseek` for the DeepSeek card (add `?force=1` to either to refresh first).
The snapshots carry amounts, counts, timestamps, error labels, the credential reference order,
and the schedule — never a key.

A DeepSeek schedule change is Host code, so it reaches the browser after the Host reloads;
without a reload the bundle's built-in copy stays in force. `deepseek.offPeak.enabled: false`
removes the phase line while the balance stays.

## Verify

```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs          # offline: fake Host context and fake browser runtime
node scripts/verify.mjs --live   # also drives the real endpoints with the stored key
```

`--live` reads `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`
and drives both real endpoints.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-purge

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**已归档会话**加一个「真正删除」按钮。DSH 能把会话归档，却从来没有删除能力。

## 插件如何工作

**界面**：每个**已归档**的会话行上会多出两个入口 —— 行内 `...` 菜单里的 **删除会话**，以及悬停时
出现的**垃圾桶按钮**。两者都先弹出确认框，写明会话名并声明不可撤销。正在使用的、或仅仅未归档的
会话上不会出现它们。

**一次删除按顺序做这些事**：

1. 拒绝**正在干活**的会话（有进行中的对话）；
2. 拒绝未归档的会话 —— 归档标记就是这次删除的授权；
3. 定位该会话的目录（`$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目键>/<会话 id>/`），并校验里面确实是它的日志，
   确保路径不对就绝不删；
4. 若宿主此刻仍加载着这个会话，先**释放**宿主的持有（只有已归档且空闲的才会释放；正在干活的
   永不释放）；
5. 递归删除该目录 —— 这个会话的全部日志世代；
6. 清掉持久记录：工作区归属与归档标记，然后通知所有已连上的界面立刻移除那一行。

**当场删不掉的情况**：正在干活的会话任何情况都不删；暂时释放不掉的会被**登记**下来
（`$DSH_HOME/archive-purge/pending.json`），在下次 DSH 启动时自动完成，也可以随时手动完成（见下）。
登记期间会话历史原样不动，**取消归档即可撤销**这次登记。

**刻意不碰**：附件（`$DSH_HOME/attachments`，跨会话共享）与投影缓存。删除不可逆，不进回收站。

## 怎么使用

**安装**（把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名）：

```powershell
# ① 从 npm 安装 —— 最短。注意包名带 scope：npm 上 dsh-archive-purge 已被别人占用
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @angela_lwh/dsh-archive-purge

# ② 直接填 GitHub 地址 —— 插件页的安装框或命令行都行
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge

# ③ 固定到某个 commit（来源不随 main 漂移，推荐给别人用）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge#<40 位完整 commit>

# ④ Release 的 tarball
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge/releases/download/v1.0.3/dsh-archive-purge-1.0.3.tgz

# ⑤ 本机已有检出 —— 改完代码即时生效，适合自己开发
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<本仓库的绝对路径>/plugin
```

五种路线都会写入 profile 依赖、把 `@angela_lwh/dsh-archive-purge` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，并装进
profile 的 `node_modules`。

仓库根目录是一个**真正的包**：根 `package.json` 是壳清单，`main` 与 `dsh.bundle.patch` 都指向
`plugin/`，所以"填仓库地址"能装。`tools/verify-package.mjs` 会校验壳清单与 `plugin/package.json`
在每个共享字段上一致、且各自声明的路径都存在（它在发布门禁里第一个跑）。

> **仍然不要用 `github:owner/repo#<sha>&path:/子目录` 这种写法**：pnpm 会把依赖别名解析成
> `包名#<sha>` 这样的非法名字并拒绝（`ERR_PNPM_INVALID_DEPENDENCY_NAME`）。
> 要指定 commit 用 ③ 那种 `#<commit>` 即可。

**使用**：

1. 把侧栏视图筛选切到 **仅显示已归档**；
2. 悬停该行点**垃圾桶图标**，或打开它的 `...` 菜单选 **删除会话**；
3. 确认。宿主能释放的会话当场删除、那一行立即消失；被登记的会话会在下次启动完成，弹窗会如实说明。

装好后侧栏 **Plugins** 页会出现「**归档会话清理**」卡片（中英双语标题与描述，跟随 app 语言），可以开关。

**手动完成被登记的删除**：任意会话行的 `...` 菜单 → **完成待删除清理** → **立即清理**。

**卸载**：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @angela_lwh/dsh-archive-purge
```

**改动后如何生效**（实测行为）：

- 浏览器半 `plugin/lib/client.js`：刷新页面即可 —— 宿主会重新快照该产物，页面随即抓取新的 bundle；
- 宿主半 `plugin/index.js`：已导入的模块需要重启 DSH，或把该 bundle 关掉再打开以重新挂载。

## 权限与副作用（如实声明）

| 项 | 事实 |
|---|---|
| 文件系统 | 读取并**递归删除** `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目键>/<会话 id>/`；写入自有的 `$DSH_HOME/archive-purge/pending.json` |
| DSH 持久状态 | 经 DSH 的 Workspace API 移除该会话的工作区归属与归档标记（`$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`） |
| 本地 HTTP | 在 DSH 已运行的 Web 服务上注册一个精确路由 `POST /api/archive-purge/deleteSession`，继承 DSH 自身的鉴权 |
| 界面 | 向两个侧栏插槽注册菜单项与悬停按钮；删除后经 `api-session/removed` 事件通知界面丢弃该行 |
| 网络 | **无**（`plugin/index.js` 只 import `node:` 内置模块） |
| 子进程 / 安装脚本 | **无**；包内没有任何 install/postinstall 脚本 |
| 外部副作用 | **不可逆地删除会话日志**，不进回收站 |
