# dsh-dock-vitals

Live **CPU / memory / GPU** readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a small clickable badge next to the built-in context meter.

```
2 turns 30 steps · 98 tok/s │ 1.8M tok · cache 84% │ 6%
CPU 13%  MEM 87%  GPU 15%
                ↑ this plugin's badge, right of the context meter
```

- **Display-only plugin.** It registers no tools for the model. Samples never enter the conversation context and are never sent anywhere.
- Three metrics out of the box — **CPU / memory / GPU**; video memory and GPU temperature are one toggle away in settings.
- GPU works across vendors, no admin rights: `nvidia-smi`, `rocm-smi`, macOS `ioreg`, and Windows PDH counters as the catch-all. Whichever backend answers is named in the snapshot, and a backend that cannot report a field leaves it blank instead of printing `0`.
- Click the badge for a details panel: per-metric values, GPU model, core count and capacity.
- Three refresh presets: **fast 1.5 s / medium 3 s / slow 10 s** (default `3000 ms`).
- Opening ten sessions still samples once — every badge shares one snapshot and one timer.
- Sampling stops on its own 15 seconds after the last reader.
- Follows the host language (Chinese / English), including the details panel and tooltips.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dock-vitals
```

Or drop the tarball in:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-dock-vitals-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

## Data sources

| Metric | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU | Node `os.cpus()` sampled twice | Machine-wide busy percentage (`1 - Δidle/Δtotal`), not per-core. The first sample has no baseline and reads empty. |
| Memory | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` | |
| GPU | A vendor CLI, probed per platform (see below) | When nothing answers, GPU shows `—` while CPU and memory keep working. |

GPU backends, tried in this order on each platform — the first that answers wins, and the winner is remembered so later ticks skip the dead ones:

| Platform | Backend | Command | Permission | Video memory / temperature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows / Linux, NVIDIA | `nvidia-smi` | `--query-gpu=... --format=csv,noheader,nounits` | none | both |
| Windows, any vendor | PDH counters via `typeperf` | `"\GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage" -sc 2 -si 1` | none | **neither** |
| Linux, AMD | `rocm-smi` | `-u --showmemuse --showmeminfo vram -t --showtemp --showproductname --csv` | none | both |
| macOS, any GPU | `ioreg` (IOKit registry) | `-r -d 1 -w 0 -c IOAccelerator` | **none** | used only (no total) |

`typeperf` is the only way to read a GPU on Windows for AMD/Intel — ROCm is Linux-only — so it is worth knowing its cost: **one round takes ~2.7 s**, where `nvidia-smi` takes ~50 ms. That is why GPU sampling is decoupled from the badge refresh rate: CPU and memory keep their own cadence, and the GPU value is served from the last completed reading.

Aggregation follows Task Manager: sum each process per engine type, then take the **busiest engine type** per adapter, then the busiest adapter. Summing every instance together over-reports, and reading only the 3D engine misses video encode/decode load entirely.

A field the active backend cannot report is `null` in the snapshot, never `0` — a missing temperature and a 0 °C temperature are different things. The details panel hides those rows rather than printing a made-up number.

The host side exposes one read-only endpoint:

```
GET /dsh-dock-vitals/snapshot
```

```json
{
  "cpu": { "percent": 13.2, "cores": 24 },
  "memory": { "usedPercent": 87.3, "usedGiB": 13.7, "totalGiB": 15.7 },
  "gpu": {
    "available": true,
    "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU",
    "utilPercent": 15,
    "memoryUsedMiB": 1816,
    "memoryTotalMiB": 8188,
    "temperatureC": 64,
    "clockMegahertz": 2370
  },
  "gpuError": null,
  "gpuBackend": "nvidia-smi",
  "host": { "platform": "win32", "release": "10.0.26300" },
  "intervalMs": 3000,
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`gpuBackend` names the backend that produced the reading, so "why is my GPU blank / missing a temperature" is answerable from the payload itself. Non-loopback callers get `403`; anything but `GET`/`HEAD` gets `405`.

## Settings

Settings → **System Status**:

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable badge | on | Off means the badge never renders and never fetches |
| CPU | on | |
| Memory | on | |
| GPU | on | |
| Video memory | off | Unavailable while GPU is off |
| GPU temperature | off | Same |
| Refresh interval | 3000 ms | 1500 – 60000 ms |

Every field is `volatile`, so changes apply immediately without a restart. Configuration lives in the settings namespace `dock-vitals` — the `id` of the plugin's entry in your profile.

## Compatibility

- dsh `>=0.2.0-rc.1` (developed and verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node `>=22`.
- Windows / macOS / Linux. CPU and memory come from Node's `os`; the GPU backends are read-only CLIs and registry reads (`nvidia-smi`, `typeperf`, `rocm-smi`, `ioreg`). Nothing needs administrator rights — this deliberately avoids `powermetrics`, which is macOS's richest GPU source but requires `sudo` on every call.
- Works in both the desktop app and the browser GUI: `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, and the desktop app is a shell around the same web frontend.

## Development notes

- Client components may only `require` modules from the host whitelist (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`). Anything else fails to resolve, and a throwing `require` kills the factory → the entry fails → the desktop build refuses to open. **Wrap every `require` in `try/catch` and ship a fallback.**
- Never call a hook inside `apply()`. `useSyncExternalStore`'s `getSnapshot` must return a **stable reference** — an object rebuilt on every call causes an infinite re-render loop.
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens only; literal colours are reserved for graphics.
- UI is contributed through `ctx.slots.inject(ownerKey, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

**PHM evidence chain** — aggregate ledger: [phm-evidence-ledger](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/phm-evidence-ledger) (5,000,086,001 units, four layers, open metrics + SHA-256 manifest) · method parent: [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) (AgentDojo-validated) · [PHM-Audit profile](https://github.com/PHM-Audit)

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-prompt-drift] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-prompt-drift` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party prompt-surface pinning, this freezes at its last
working version with a postmortem here.

plugins.description: DSH plugin — Token usage panel inside DeepSeek Harness settings: daily heatmap, 30-day trend, per-session breakdown and cost estimate.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-usage-panel

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DSH%20Web%20%2F%20Desktop-6cb6ff)](#兼容性)

> **在 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置」里看每天花了多少 Token。**
> 不用离开 DSH，也不用另开网页：设置 → `Token 用量`，就是一张 GitHub 风格的每日消耗热力图。

浅色主题：

![设置里的 Token 用量面板（浅色）](docs/preview-light.png)

深色主题：

![设置里的 Token 用量面板（深色）](docs/preview-dark.png)

---

## 功能

- **今日消耗**：总量，加上「输出 / 未缓存输入 / 缓存命中」三色明细；填了单价还会显示当天估算金额。
- **指标网格**：近 7 天、近 30 天、累计、活跃天数、连续使用天数、缓存命中率。
- **每日消耗热力图**：最近 53 周，GitHub 贡献图那种；颜色越深＝当天消耗越多。
  悬停看当天四类 token 明细，**点格子**展开「当天明细」（当天各会话的占比）。
- **最近 30 天趋势**：输出 / 未缓存输入 / 缓存命中 的堆叠柱状图，带网格线和峰值刻度。
- **会话明细**：可排序、可搜索；窄面板自动精简列，宽面板额外显示工作区、缓存命中和 30 天迷你条。
- **按模型 / 按工作区**汇总。
- **成本估算**：填单价（元 / 百万 token）自动换算金额；价格只存在你本机浏览器里。

界面完全使用 DSH 自己的设计变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），**浅色 / 深色主题自动适配**；
面板宽度会随设置面板变化（实测 ~590px 也能完整放下 53 周热力图）。

## 安装

> 需要已安装 DeepSeek Harness（Web 或桌面版），且能正常使用 `dsh` 命令。

### 方式 A：在 DSH 里点几下（推荐）

1. 打开 DSH 侧边栏的 **插件（Plugins）** 页 → 安装。
2. 填入：

   ```
   github:Jun-Jun-Gao/dsh-token-usage-panel
   ```

3. 安装完成后会**自动启用**这个 bundle。若面板没立刻出现，刷新一次页面。

### 方式 B：命令行

```bash
# 1) 安装到你的 profile（desktop 为例；Web 版通常是 web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Jun-Jun-Gao/dsh-token-usage-panel

# 2) 把它选为 profile 的一层（bundle）
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json，在 dsh.profile.bundles 里加上：
#      "dsh-token-usage-panel"
```

第 2 步等价于让它出现在「插件」页被勾选；改完 DSH 会热重载，或重启应用生效。

### 方式 C：本地开发 / 手动

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jun-Jun-Gao/dsh-token-usage-panel.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-token-usage-panel
# 然后在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 插入一行（不想选 bundle 时这样也行）：
#   - insert:
#       - id: ui-settings-token-usage
#         name: 'dsh-token-usage-panel'
```

## 使用

打开 DSH **设置**，左侧导航里选 **Token 用量**。

- 热力图按**本机时区的自然日**归档；颜色分 4 档，按「当天消耗 / 历史单日最大值」划分。
- 面板默认每 30 秒自动刷新一次，也可以点「刷新」；正在进行的会话也会被算进去。
- 「成本估算」四个单价留空即不显示金额；`清空` 按钮会清掉本机保存的价格。

## 统计口径

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 未缓存输入 | 真正按输入价计费的 prompt token |
| 缓存命中 | 命中 prompt cache 的部分（单价通常最低） |
| 输出 | 模型生成的 token（含思维链） |
| **合计** | 以上四项之和，也就是服务商后台看到的那个总量 |

因为每一步都会重发上下文，「合计」通常被**缓存命中**主导（实测占比 99%+），
所以真正贵的是「未缓存输入 + 输出」两项——面板把它们单独列出来就是为此。

## 工作原理

```
DSH Host 进程                                 浏览器
┌───────────────────────────────┐            ┌────────────────────────────┐
│ lib/index.js                  │            │ lib/client.js              │
│  · 扫描 $DSH_HOME/sessions/   │  GET       │  · 注册 settings.section   │
│    **/session*.jsonl.zstd     │ ─────────► │  · 拉取数据并渲染面板      │
│  · 聚合到「每天 / 每会话」     │ /token-    │  · 成本估算存 localStorage │
│  · 注册只读路由 /token-usage  │  usage/data│                            │
└───────────────────────────────┘            └────────────────────────────┘
```

- 数据来源是 DSH 自己写的会话日志里，每一条 `assistant/message` 的 `usage` 字段。
- 这些日志是**多帧拼接**的 zstd 文件（每追加一次一个帧），而 Node 的 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`
  只解第一帧。所以 Host 侧按 zstd 魔数切帧、逐帧解压，并在误切时自动合并重试——
  **不需要外部 `zstd` 命令**。
- 解析结果按「文件大小 + mtime」做增量缓存，历史会话再多刷新也很快。
- 只读本机文件，**不联网、不上传**，也不注册任何模型可见的东西（模型看不到这个面板）。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-token-usage-panel
# 并在 profile 的 package.json 里把 "dsh-token-usage-panel" 从 dsh.profile.bundles 移掉
```

## 兼容性

- 开发与验证环境：**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**（Electron 44 / Node 24.18）下的 Web GUI 与桌面版。
- 本包**没有声明** `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peerDependencies，所以不会被版本范围拒装；
  如果你在更新的 DSH 上遇到问题，欢迎开 issue 附上 DSH 版本。
- 面板用的是 `settings.section`、`ctx.locale`、`ctx.webServer.register` 这几个公开扩展点。

## 开发

```bash
# Host 侧可以脱离应用单独跑（会打印扫描结果）
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness" lib/index.js

# 应用运行中时，直接看接口：
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-web-port>/token-usage/health
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-web-port>/token-usage/data | head -c 300
```

- `lib/index.js`：Host 侧（扫描 + 聚合 + 路由），零依赖。
- `lib/client.js`：浏览器侧，一个自带 `CSS` 常量的自包含 bundle（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），
  只 `require('react')`（DSH 的 platform seed 提供）。
- 改完代码后 touch 一下 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 让 DSH 热重载，或重启应用。

提交前可以跑一下 CI 同款检查：

```bash
npm run check      # 语法 + DSH 清单校验
```

## English

**dsh-token-usage-panel** adds a *Token usage* section to DeepSeek Harness settings:
today's usage with a per-kind breakdown, a GitHub-style 53-week daily heatmap
(click a cell for that day's per-session split), a stacked 30-day chart,
sortable session details and an optional cost estimate.

Install from the DSH **Plugins** page with `github:Jun-Jun-Gao/dsh-token-usage-panel`,
or `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Jun-Jun-Gao/dsh-token-usage-panel` and
select `dsh-token-usage-panel` in `dsh.profile.bundles`.

The host half reads the session logs under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` (nothing leaves
your machine) and serves them at `GET /token-usage/data`; the client half renders
inside the settings sheet and follows DSH's own light/dark design tokens.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 手绘素描风皮肤：纸 + 墨的单色观感，给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上一套手绘墨黑主题
plugins.readme_text:
# 手绘素描风皮肤 · dsh-handdrawn-skin

> 给 **DeepSeek Harness** Web 界面换上「纸 + 墨」的单色素描观感。
> A hand-drawn ink-on-paper skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

<!-- 预览图：把截图放到 preview/light.png（深色主题放 preview/dark.png），
     然后取消下面这行的注释即可 -->
<!-- ![预览 / Preview](preview/light.png) -->

---

## 特点

- **纸** — 中性暖白纸底。宿主原本是纯白（`#fff`），这里按**同明度暖化**只偏色相、明度压低约 2%，所以层次、对比度、留白观感全部保持原样。
- **墨** — 宿主用品牌蓝 `#4176e6` 做所有强调色（发送按钮、标签下划线、链接、"deep diving" 状态、气泡高亮…），本皮肤一律换成**墨黑**，得到纸墨素描的黑白观感。
- **质感** — 3.5% 牛皮纸颗粒、0.15px 马克笔轻描边、铅笔细线、楷体标题。全部调淡，有质感但不抢戏。
- **克制** — 不碰布局：圆角、间距、字号、字重基准、阴影全部交给宿主。**零实心边框**，细线是靠加深宿主原有的 `.5px` 线得到的。
- **兼容** — 只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌，不改任何元素结构，因此不会和宿主或其它插件抢样式。浅色 / 深色主题均已适配。
- 功能状态色（错误红 / 成功绿 / 警告琥珀）保持宿主默认，不做改动。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：`dsh plugin`（推荐）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dd598/dsh-handdrawn-skin.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add ./dsh-handdrawn-skin
```

### 方式二：手动放进 profile

```bash
# 1) 复制到目标 profile 的 node_modules
cp -r dsh-handdrawn-skin ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/

# 2) 在该 profile 的 package.json 里登记两处：
#    dependencies:            "dsh-handdrawn-skin": "file:<绝对路径>/dsh-handdrawn-skin"
#    dsh.profile.bundles 末尾: "dsh-handdrawn-skin"
```

> **profile 别选错**：Desktop 客户端读的是 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`，
> `dsh --profile web` 读的是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。装到客户端不读的那个 profile 不会生效。
> 客户端用哪个 profile 写在它的启动命令行里（`...dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js ... <profile 路径> ...`）。

**重启客户端**后生效 —— 组合树在启动时构建。

---

## 实现方式

皮肤是一个标准的 DSH bundle 插件：`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，把自己 insert 进组合树；浏览器半部通过 lazy-CJS 协议注入一段 CSS，且所有样式都挂在 `body[data-dsh-handdrawn]` 之下，禁用时整块摘掉、可完全还原。

覆盖的 30 个设计令牌（浅色 / 深色各一套）：

| 分组 | 令牌 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 纸张 | `bg-base` / `bg-layer-1..3` / `bg-overlay` / `specific-sidebar-fill` / `specific-input-major` / `specific-selector` / `specific-bubble` |
| 墨色文字 | `label-primary` / `label-secondary` / `label-tertiary` / `brand-primary` |
| 细线 | `border-l1..l4` / `border-l2-darkmode-thin` |
| 手绘墨黑 | `state-business-primary` / `-hover` / `-tertiary` / `button-info-fill` / `-hover` / `link` / `label-primary-bluish` / `label-deep-diving` / `-shimmer` / `specific-bubble-highlight` / `specific-sidebar-nav-item-active-accent` / `bg-document-selection` |

元素级规则只有 4 条，且都走宿主公开契约（不用 CSS-module 的构建哈希）：

| 效果 | 选择器 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 牛皮纸颗粒 | `body[data-dsh-handdrawn]::after`（固定覆盖层） |
| 马克笔轻描边 | `:is(p,span,li,h1…,button,a)` |
| 楷体标题 | `[class*="headline"]` |
| 输入卡片墨线 | `[data-composer-card]` 的 `--dsw-elevation-stroke-color` |

---

## 想调手感

都在 `client/client.js` 顶部：

| 想要 | 改哪里 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 纸色更暖 / 更白 | `${S}` 块里的 `--dsw-alias-bg-base`（`#FBF9F4` 更暖，`#FEFEFC` 几乎纯白） |
| 纸纹浓淡 | `GRAIN` 里的 `opacity='0.035'` |
| 描边粗细 | `-webkit-text-stroke:.15px` |
| 细线深浅 | `--dsw-alias-border-l1..l4` 的末两位十六进制（透明度） |
| 墨色浓淡 | `--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` / `button-info-fill`（当前 `#26221C`） |

改完同步进 profile 再重启即可：

```bash
cp client/client.js ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-handdrawn-skin/client/client.js
```

---

## 兼容性

- 需要带 Web UI 的 DSH（Desktop 客户端或 `dsh web` 均可）。
- 依赖宿主的 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌层。若宿主大版本改动令牌命名或语义，需要相应更新。
- 皮肤作用域为 `body[data-dsh-handdrawn]`，卸载 / 停用后可完全还原，不留残留。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: WxPusher + real browser notifications (sound, requireInteraction) for DeepSeek Harness session state changes — session stopped, exited with an error, or asked you a question. Native settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notify

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Session-state notifications for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): a **WxPusher push** plus a **real browser notification** — with sound and `requireInteraction` — whenever a session stops, exits with an error, or asks you a question. Everything is configured from a native settings page (设置 → 通知 / Settings → Notifications).

- **Two independent channels, one payload.** The Host detects the transition once and delivers the same content to WxPusher and to every open browser page.
- **Real system notifications.** `new Notification(...)` with a PNG icon, an optional WebAudio chime, and `requireInteraction` so the banner stays until you dismiss it.
- **Native settings page.** A `settings.section` page built from the plugin's own Config schema; every field is `volatile`, so edits apply **live** — no restart, no plugin remount.
- **Write-only secret.** The WxPusher `appToken` is declared `role('secret')`: it is stored in the profile, never returned over the wire, and edited through a path-addressed write.
- **Zero runtime dependencies beyond the schema library.** One Host file, one Client file, no build step.

## What triggers a notification

| Event | Source | Detail shown |
|---|---|---|
| **Session stopped** | `api-session/status` → `running: false` | the folded session title |
| **Exited with an error** | `api-session/error`, `agent/error` | the error message |
| **Question asked** | `user-questions/request` (observed, then delegated) | the first question |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` (observed, then delegated) | the tool name |

Two filters keep the noise down:

- **`minRunMs`** — a run shorter than this never reports a stop.
- **`stopDebounceMs`** — after the agent goes idle the Host waits this long; if the session starts running again the report is dropped. A stop is also suppressed when an error notification for the same session just fired, because that one is more precise.

`user-questions/request` and `approval/request` are Cordis **waterfalls**: this plugin only observes them and always delegates with `next()`, so it can never swallow a request meant for another answerer.

## Requirements

- A DSH Host with the Web surface (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`), i.e. any normal `dsh web` profile. `ctx.webServer` is used for the notification stream; without it the plugin still pushes to WxPusher but delivers nothing to the browser.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- A browser that supports the Notification API (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 16+).
- A [WxPusher](https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com) account, only if you want phone pushes.

## Install

### Through the plugin manager (recommended)

Add the package spec to the Plugins page — a registry name, a git URL, or an absolute path to a checkout — and enable the bundle it adds:

```
dsh-plugin-notify
```

or, from a clone:

```
/path/to/dsh-plugin-notify
```

The plugin's row is declared by the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`, so nothing else needs editing. If the profile was already running, reload it (or restart) so the new package enters the module-resolution table.

### Manually, in a profile

```bash
# in the profile directory, e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-notify
```

Then add the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-plugin-notify"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Configure

Open **Settings → Notifications** (设置 → 通知). The page writes straight into the plugin's profile entry.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for both channels. |
| `events.stopped` | `true` | Report a session that stopped working. |
| `events.error` | `true` | Report a session or step that errored. |
| `events.question` | `true` | Report a question from the agent. |
| `events.approval` | `false` | Report a pending approval decision. |
| `browser.enabled` | `true` | Raise browser notifications at all. |
| `browser.sound` | `true` | Play a short two-tone chime (WebAudio, no asset). |
| `browser.requireInteraction` | `true` | Keep the banner until dismissed. |
| `browser.onlyWhenHidden` | `true` | Stay quiet while the tab is visible. |
| `wxpusher.enabled` | `false` | Enable the WxPusher channel. |
| `wxpusher.appToken` | `''` | WxPusher `appToken` (**write-only secret**). |
| `wxpusher.uids` | `[]` | Receiving UIDs, one per line (`UID_xxxxxxxx`). |
| `wxpusher.topicIds` | `[]` | Receiving topic ids, one per line. |
| `wxpusher.url` | `''` | Optional URL a tapped push opens. |
| `advanced.stopDebounceMs` | `1200` | Idle grace period before reporting a stop. |
| `advanced.minRunMs` | `2000` | Runs shorter than this never notify. |
| `advanced.rootSessionsOnly` | `true` | Skip subagent sessions. |
| `advanced.includeSessionTitle` | `true` | Include the folded session title. |
| `advanced.maxDetailChars` | `300` | Truncate error/question detail. |

The same values live in the profile patch, so they survive upgrades:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-notify
  config:
    events:
      approval: true
    wxpusher:
      enabled: true
      uids:
        - UID_xxxxxxxx
```

### WxPusher credentials

1. Sign in at <https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com>, create an application, and copy its **appToken**.
2. Follow the app's QR code with WeChat to subscribe, then copy your **UID** from the app's user list (or use a **topic id** to reach many subscribers).
3. Paste the appToken and the UIDs into the settings page and press **Save**.

The appToken input is always empty on load — the Host only ever reports *whether* a token is set.

### Browser permission

The page shows the current `Notification.permission`. If it is `default`, press **Request permission**; if it is `denied`, re-allow notifications for the page in your browser's site settings. Sound needs one user gesture on the page before the browser lets an `AudioContext` start — the plugin hooks the first click/keypress to unlock it.

### Test

Each channel card owns its own test button, so a test never leaves you guessing which card it belongs to:

| Card | Button | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Browser notifications** | *Send a test notification* | Broadcasts a frame to every connected page **and** pushes one WxPusher message — a full-stack probe. |
| **WxPusher push** | *Send a test push* | Pushes one WxPusher message only. It raises no system notification, and it works while `wxpusher.enabled` is still off, so credentials can be verified before switching the channel on. |

Each button reports its own outcome underneath:

```
Browser: delivered to 1 page(s) · WxPusher: sent
WxPusher: no appToken
WxPusher: refused (appToken不正确)
Browser: no connected page (browser notifications may be off) · WxPusher: no UID or topic id
```

The buttons call the same endpoint with a `channel` selector — see below.

## How it works

```
Host                                    Browser
────                                    ───────
api-session/status ─┐
api-session/error  ─┤
agent/error        ─┼─► detect ─► frame ─┬─► WxPusher HTTPS push
user-questions/…   ─┤                    │
approval/request   ─┘                    └─► GET /dsh-plugin-notify/events (SSE)
                                                        │
                                                        ▼
                                            new Notification(title, {
                                              body, icon, tag,
                                              requireInteraction, silent,
                                            })  +  WebAudio chime
```

- The Host plugin registers two exact routes on `ctx.webServer`: the SSE stream at `/dsh-plugin-notify/events` and the test endpoint at `/dsh-plugin-notify/test`.
- The Client half opens an `EventSource` on the **document-relative** path `dsh-plugin-notify/events`, so it resolves under whatever mount served the page and inherits the page's own authentication. `EventSource` reconnects by itself; the Host sends a `: ping` heartbeat every 25 s.
- The settings page resolves its namespace from `

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-team-chat > **English summary** — A multi-AI collaboration chatroom inside the existing DSH (DeepSeek Harness) UI: it restores the mailbox timeline that the stock Agent Teams wire projection drops, and adds member avatars and `@` dispatch. > **Install:** `dsh plugin add dsh-team-chat` (recommended, from npm). The tarball and from-source alternatives are in the 安装 / Install section below. Then restart DSH for the host half and reload the page for the client half. > **Highlights:** realtime mailbox timeline, member roster with avatars, `@` dispatch to one member, and the `chatroom_read` / `chatroom_send` tools. > **Language:** the settings UI follows the host language setting — Chinese and English dictionaries are both built in. **Model-facing prompts stay in Chinese** by design. > **License:** MIT. 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端写的插件：在**现有界面内**提供多 AI 实时协作聊天室。 ## 安装 / Install **✅ 推荐 / Recommended —— 从 npm 安装（用包名，不要手抄 tarball 地址）：** ```bash dsh plugin add dsh-team-chat ``` *装完按提示重启 DSH；客户端那一半刷新页面即可生效。* *Restart DSH when prompted; reload the page for the client half.* ### 备选方式 / Alternatives **① tarball —— 直接装打包文件 / install the packed tarball** ```bash dsh plugin add https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-team-chat/-/dsh-team-chat-0.1.0.tgz ``` **② 源码 —— clone 后把本地目录链接进 profile / from source: clone and link the folder** ```bash git clone https://github.com/MoYu-CN/dsh-team-chat.git dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-team-chat" ``` `link:` 不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效 —— 适合要改插件本身的场景。 `link:` symlinks instead of copying, so local edits take effect immediately — use it when you want to modify the plugin itself. ## 它解决什么 DSH 官方的 **Agent Teams** 已经有具名 teammate、持久 mailbox、共享任务板 （带 compare-and-set 防互相覆盖）。但原生的 Web 面板有两个洞： 1. **没有 mailbox timeline** —— 官方 wire 投影只输出 `{ members, tasks, failure }`， 把消息丢掉了。数据其实完好地存在投影 state 的 `messages` 数组里。 2. **任务板只读**，面板不给任何修改控件。 本插件补上第 1 点：把官方丢掉的消息事件接回来，做成一条实时时间线。 ## 界面 ### 聊天室时间线 ![聊天室时间线](docs/room-overview.png) *聊天室视图：左侧是成员时间线，底部输入框仍是宿主官方 composer。* *The chatroom view: the member timeline on the left, with the host's own composer kept at the bottom.* ### 成员面板 ![成员面板](docs/members-panel.png) *成员面板：显示成员数与「添加 AI 成员」入口，每行可打开对话 / 编辑资料 / 移除。* *The members panel: member count, the "add AI member" entry, and per-row actions to open, edit or remove.* > 上面两张只示意面板形状 —— 成员名已被裁断/模糊，不是任何成员的真实名字。 > Both images only show the panel's shape: the member name is cropped or blurred and is not any member's real name. ### 设置 →「聊天室」 ![聊天室设置](docs/settings-row.png) *聊天室设置：我（发言人）的显示名与头像、官方 Agent Teams 开关（本插件不需要）、AI 成员配置。* *The chatroom settings row: the speaker's own name and avatar, the stock Agent Teams switch (not needed by this plugin), and the AI member list.* > 截图取自开发机上的实测界面：其中的成员名、署名与对话内容都是**虚构的测试数据**，不是插件的一部分。 > These screenshots come from a real development machine: the member names, bylines and chat text > in them are **fictional test data**, not part of the plugin. ## 原理（一句话） 注册一个**平行的** session projection，监听同一个事件流里的 `team/message/queued` / `team/message/delivered`，攒成可直接渲染的条目， 再通过 `wire.view` 交给前端渲染（SSE 兜底）。 **不修改官方包，只用公开 API** —— `ctx.sessionProjections.register()` 是官方 自己的 `agentTeam` 投影在用的同一个入口，`wire` 字段也是官方契约。 官方升级不会冲突。 ## 遵循的官方规范 本插件按 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/skills/cordis-plugin-development/` 编写： | 规则 | 落实 | |---|---| | 不 `require` 任何 Harness Client 包 | `client.js` 只 `require("react")` + `require("react-dom")`（两者都在 `staticModules` 种子里）；开关控件照抄 primitive 实现，类名 `tc-switch` 前缀，只留 `--dsw-alias-*` token | | UI 是 slot 里的 React 组件，不用 iframe | 走 `conversation.view` / `conversation.session.header.actions` / `conversation.input.left` / `settings.general.item` 四个 slot | | 会话派生值走 Host 投影的 `wire.view` | `timeline-projection.js` 声明 `wire: { viewSchema, view }`，Client 不自己折叠事件 | | `apply` 内用 `ctx.effect` 注册资源并返回清理 | 字典、五个 slot、权限影子都包在 effect 里 | | 显示元数据放 `locale/*.json` + 顶层 `icon` | `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`、`icon.svg` | | 槽必须先声明才能注册 | 一律走 `ctx.slots.inject(name, cb)` 延迟注册；直接 `register` 未声明槽会抛 | ### 槽位目录是第一手资料 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner/lib/client.js` 里的 `CLIENT_SLOT_API` 列出了**全部 89 个槽**，每个都带 `kind` / `scope` / `ownerProps` / `standardProps` / `occupants` / **官方范例代码** / `declaredBy`。 排查「这个槽能不能用、怎么用」直接查它，不要猜： ```sh # 用 C:/wb-tmp/slot-catalog.mjs 抽取（composer | header | sidebar | always | detail ） node slot-catalog.mjs detail conversation.session.header.actions ``` ## 当前状态 **已安装进 DSH 并跑通。** 已实现： - [x] `lib/timeline-projection.js` —— 核心投影逻辑（纯函数 + `wire.view`） - [x] `lib/member-store.js` —— 成员资料持久化（显示名 + 职责 + 头像，原子写、永不抛错） - [x] `lib/index.js` —— host：投影 + SSE + 7 条路由 + 客户端注入 - [x] `lib/client.js` —— `conversation.view` 聊天室视图（带头像的时间线） - [x] `lib/client.js` —— **去掉权限按钮**（影子 `conversation.input.permission`，**按会话门控**） - [x] `lib/client.js` —— 「成员管理」按钮 → **打开右侧栏页签**（`sidebar.right.pane.tab`） - [x] `lib/client.js` —— 成员编辑：显示名/职责/头像 + 添加 AI 成员 + 删除资料 - [x] `lib/client.js` —— 输入框工具栏左侧「发送到团队」成员选择器（`conversation.input.left`） - [x] `lib/client.js` —— 设置项：一键启用官方 Agent Teams - [x] `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `locale/*` / `icon.svg` 尚未做： - [ ] `sidebar.panellist` 左侧「聊天室」按钮 - [ ] **右栏成员页签的真机 UI 实测** —— `openTab` 的时序依赖运行时挂载状态， 脚手架只能验到「注册契约正确」，必须人点一次确认 - [ ] 玩家从聊天室发言走真正的 Team 协议（当前只写官方 draft） **安装实测状态**（2026-09-27 03:35）： ``` ✅ node_modules/dsh-team-chat -> D:/AI同步插件/dsh-team-chat ✅ profile bundles 含 dsh-team-chat ✅ dump-config 解析出 {id: team-chat, name: dsh-team-chat, inject: [webServer, sessionProjections]} ✅ 4 个端点全 200（config / client.js / timeline / members） ✅ 本次启动零 renderer 报错、零「without inject」、无「N entry did not activate」 ⚠ "dsh-team-chat -> dsh-team-chat+0.1.0+4ff6a3b6edc7" 迁移本身成功了， 但同批次的 @local/dsh-ai-knowledge 拉了 npm 404，整批回滚 → 退回 link: 形态。 功能不受影响，只让 profile maintenance 冻结（见「安装」章节坑 ③） ``` ## 成员菜单编辑功能（2026-09-27 第二轮） ### 铁律：成员身份不可改，只能改「展示层覆写」 官方 `team/member` 事件里的 `name` / `provider` / `context` 是**不可变身份字段**。 往 Team 协议层写回这些字段，官方会直接抛 `teammate "..." changed immutable identity fields`。 所以「改名字 / 改职责 / 换头像」**一律只落 `MemberStore`**（`members.json`）， 客户端按 `memberKey` 查表覆写显示。`memberKey` 用稳定标识（teammate 名或 sessionId）， 不用展示名 —— 改名字不能让资料丢失。 「职责」对应官方 roster row 的 `description`（`spawn` 时写的，上限 200）。 本地 `duty` 有值时盖过它，为空则回退官方描述： ```js duty: profile?.duty ? profile.duty : (description ?? "") ``` `rosterOf()` 必须把官方 `description` / `avatar` 一路带出来，否则回退没有数据源。 ### 头像三态 `emoji` / `text` / `image` 三种。图片走 data URL（本地 `FileReader` 读，不落盘不上传）， 两道 60 KiB 上限：客户端读文件时拦一次，宿主 `normalizeMember` 再拦一次。 宿主侧只认 `data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp|avif);base64,...`，外链和 `data:text/*` 一律丢弃 —— 避免把 `` 变成 SSRF / XSS 的入口。 清空头像是显式信号 `avatar: null`。`set()` 里要先把它摘出来再合并， 否则 `{...previous, ...member}` 会把它当普通属性写进磁盘，读回就是一条脏记录。 ### 添加 AI 成员：必须走宿主代理 唯一的公开入口是宿主侧的 `ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate(caller, request)`，准入链很硬： 1. `caller` 必须是**精确的 live Lead Agent 对象** —— `TeamRoster.tryMembership` 里 `this.ctx.agents.get(agent.id) !== agent` 直接拒。 身份靠**对象同一性**，任何重建/缓存的副本都算过期引用。 2. 只有 `role === "lead"` 能调，否则 `TEAM_LEAD_REQUIRED`。 3. `name` 必须匹配 `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/u`、≤64、且不能是 `"lead"`。 4. `description` 必填，≤200。 浏览器端**拿不到**宿主 Agent 对象（跨端），所以新增路由 `POST /__teamchat/spawn`： 宿主侧 `findLiveAgent()` 按 sessionId 找到同一个引用，再转调官方。 `agentTeams` **不进 `inject`**：Cordis 的 `inject` 是硬依赖，服务不存在时 fiber 停在 pending，整个插件（含聊天室视图）都起不来。改用 `ctx.get("agentTeams")` 按需取， 缺失时返回 `503 TEAM_UNAVAILABLE`，客户端降级为「让 Lead 自己调 spawn_teammate」的提示。 官方错误码原样透传（`TEAM_MEMBER_NAME_TAKEN` / `TEAM_MEMBER_LIMIT` / ...）， 客户端按 code 而非消息文本挑文案。 ### 过渡动画 只用 `transform` / `opacity`（不碰 width/height，避免 layout thrash）， 时长贴齐已有先例 `.tc-switch-thumb { transition: transform 120ms ease; }`： ```css .tc-panel { transform-origin: top right; animation: tc-panel-in 140ms ease both; } @keyframes tc-panel-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px) scale(.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } .tc-stage { animation: tc-stage-in 150ms ease both; } @keyframes tc-stage-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } ``` 面板三个阶段（`list` / `edit` / `add`）互斥，靠 React `key` 换元素触发 `.tc-stage` 重播动画。 Escape 键在非列表态先退回列表，再按一次才关闭面板。 `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` 下动画全关。 ### 坑 - **`avatar: null` 别直接 spread 进 state**（见上）。 - **`

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-global-prompt

在 DeepSeek Harness 设置里保存跨会话的固定指令：一个开关、一段文本，作用于安装此插件的 profile。

[下载 v0.2.0 预览版](https://github.com/Humengjiu/dsh-global-prompt/releases/tag/v0.2.0) · [English](README.en.md) · [验证记录](docs/validation.md)

独立社区插件，由 Humengjiu 维护，采用 MIT 协议；未经 DeepSeek 官方收录。

## 兼容范围

| 插件版本 | 已验证的 dsh |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.0 | 官方发布版 **0.2.1-alpha.2**，tag `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2`，提交 `d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c` |
| 0.1.0 | 原开发分支快照，见 [历史预览版](https://github.com/Humengjiu/dsh-global-prompt/releases/tag/v0.1.0) |

本次已在 Windows 上使用官方 npm 发布包验证 Web 安装和实际网页操作。桌面应用使用相同的 Web 插件协议，但尚未单独进行桌面安装验收。未来 dsh 版本可能改变插件 API；本包声明准确的版本要求，不需要设置兼容性豁免。

## 安装到 Web

1. 确认 dsh 版本为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`。
2. 下载 `dsh-global-prompt-0.2.0.tgz`。
3. 在终端执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-global-prompt-0.2.0.tgz
```

然后重新启动 dsh Web，打开 **设置 → 全局提示词**。打开开关后输入固定指令，等待保存完成。

安装包自带 profile 组合层，会自动注册 `global-prompt` 条目；无需修改 dsh 源码，也不需要旧版 `--patch global-prompt.patch.yml`。含空格的文件路径请加引号。也可在 dsh 的社区插件安装界面使用该预览版安装包的下载 URL。

首次安装默认启用。若这是更新已安装的旧包，官方会保留其启用状态；设置入口未出现时，在侧栏「插件」中启用 `dsh-global-prompt`，再按提示重启。

默认关闭、文本为空。设置通过官方实时 ConfigForms 保存到对应 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，默认 Web 路径为 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`。服务端对过期的编辑版本进行冲突检查；保存失败会显示提示，当前页面的文本草稿保留并可重试。远端连接或只读状态下不进行 Host 写入。

## 从 0.1.0 升级

旧版使用独立的 `settings.yaml` 命名空间；新版使用官方 volatile Config 和 profile patch。请保留旧文件，移除旧版启动覆盖文件的使用，再安装新版组合包。详细步骤和不覆盖原文件的迁移工具见 [升级指南](docs/upgrade-v0.2.md)。

## 行为与模型影响

启用且文本非空白时，`user:global-prompt` 在 deployment persona prefix 之后贡献原文；关闭、清空或只有空白时不贡献内容。包括 `{{variable}}` 在内的文本会按字面保留，不作为 dsh 插值表达式执行。每次组装读取当前实时配置；修改会通知提示词消费者，不重启插件。

内容增加对应的模型输入 token；修改会改变 KV-cache 前缀。作用范围是安装该组合包的 profile 内的会话。官方明确声明的完整 system prompt 会覆盖其他 section，这个规则仍然有效。

## 开发

开发依赖直接来自官方已发布的 npm 包，不再依赖克隆旧开发分支。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm run build
pnpm run smoke
pnpm run pack
```

Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm 11.28.5。构建生成 Node 入口、浏览器闭包工厂、CSS 和类型声明；预览包输出到 `dist/`。GitHub Actions 验证通过后，带版本的 tag 会发布预览包、源码包和校验文件。

## 验证与限制

已验证真实 Loader/profile 持久化与重启、官方浏览器设置/renderer/locale 工厂、保存失败草稿和重试、真实 dsh Web 安装、启用、输入、刷新恢复和关闭。具体结果见 [验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

未进行真实模型 API 调用、桌面应用安装或移动端验收。每次文本变化仍单独排队保存，尚未增加防抖。该插件没有发布到 npm，本次通过 GitHub 预览包交付。

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-yuantoutao [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) **The e-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness.** One plugin gives your AI full commerce abilities — product search, coupon-aware comparison, affiliate buy links and order fulfillment — across 50k+ curated products on Taobao, JD and Pinduoduo, through one Streamable HTTP MCP server. **Keywords**: e-commerce MCP server · DeepSeek Harness plugin · AI shopping agent · product search · price comparison · Taobao / Tmall / JD / Pinduoduo (淘宝 京东 拼多多) · affiliate buy links · order fulfillment · 源头淘 ## Highlights 功能亮点 - **Conversational shopping 对话购物** — natural-language product search with budget and preference ("gift under ¥500", "cheapest, must be genuine") - **Explainable ranking 可解释排序** — every item ships a score + per-factor reasons (price vs category average, shop tier, sales, coupon) you can quote directly - **Live fan-out 实时扇出** — parallel Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo official channel queries - **Affiliate monetization 变现** — every buy link is attributed; 3% developer share on attributed purchases, settled monthly - **End-to-end fulfillment 履约闭环** — idempotent orders, WeChat pay QR/redirect, waybill tracking, free-return pickups ## Zero-friction: works without any API key Install, done. Read-only shopping tools (search 50k+ products, comparison, buy links) work **keylessly** — no signup, no token, quota-free local shelf. Add a free API key only when you want **commissions** (live fan-out, orders, 3% developer share, withdrawal). Free keys never expire: mint at [yuantoutao.com/console](https://yuantoutao.com/console/) or request `POST https://mcp.yuantoutao.com/mcp/trial`. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin add github:yuantoutao/dsh-plugin-yuantoutao # then restart: dsh web (or dsh headless) ``` ## Configure Set your API key (free developer key at [yuantoutao.com/console](https://yuantoutao.com/console/)): ```sh export YUANTOUTAO_API_KEY=ak_your_key ``` Or in your profile's config: `apiKey` (plugin config), alongside optional `url`, `serverName`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`, `failOnStartupError`. ## Tools (namespace `mcp__yuantoutao__*`) | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `cps_smart_search` | Flagship shopping search: natural language + budget + balanced/quality/price modes, explainable 3-factor score per item, optional live fan-out to Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo | | `cps_compare` | Side-by-side matrix for 2–6 items (price vs category average, coupon, shop tier, spec lines) | | `shelf_search` / `shelf_item` | Local curated shelf (no platform quota), relevance/sales/price/latest sort | | `cps_search_shops` / `cps_item_info` / `cps_tpwd` | Taobao: shop search, item details, taobao-password (out-of-app sharing) | | `cps_jd_goods_search` / `cps_jd_convert` / `cps_jd_orders` | JD: keyword search (review counts), affiliate links, order details | | `cps_pdd_goods_search` / `cps_pdd_convert` / `cps_pdd_orders` | Pinduoduo: keyword search, goods_sign affiliate links, order details | | `cps_eleme_convert` | Ele.me official activity link (food delivery red packets) | | `search_goods` / `get_goods_detail` / `create_order` / `get_order_status` / `get_logistics` / `request_aftersale` | Fulfillment flow (server-computed pricing, idempotent orders, tracked shipping, free pickups) | Full docs: [llms.txt](https://yuantoutao.com/llms.txt) · [API console](https://yuantoutao.com/console/) ## License MIT
